<file path="Sohba/Views/Dashboard/Reports.cshtml">
@model Sohba.ViewModels.Dashboard.DashboardReportsViewModel
@{
    ViewData["Title"] = "Manage Reports";
    // Layout = "~/Views/Shared/_Layout.cshtml";
    Layout = "_AppLayout";
}

<div class="max-w-7xl mx-auto page-transition">
    <!-- Header -->
    <div class="bg-white rounded-3xl shadow-sm border border-slate-100 p-6 mb-6">
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
            <div>
                <h1 class="text-3xl font-black text-gray-900">Reports</h1>
                <p class="text-gray-500 mt-1">Manage user reports</p>
            </div>
            <div class="text-sm text-gray-500">
                Total: <span class="font-bold text-gray-900">@Model.TotalCount</span>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Filters -->
        <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-4 mt-6">
            <select id="statusFilter" class="px-4 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#345e69]/20">
                <option value="pending" selected="@(Model.StatusFilter == "pending")">Pending Reports</option>
                <option value="resolved" selected="@(Model.StatusFilter == "resolved")">Resolved Reports</option>
                <option value="all" selected="@(Model.StatusFilter == "all")">All Reports</option>
            </select>
            <button onclick="applyFilters()" class="px-6 py-2 bg-[#345e69] text-white font-semibold rounded-xl hover:bg-[#2a4b55] transition-colors">
                Apply Filters
            </button>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Reports Table -->
    <div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-100 overflow-hidden">
        <div class="overflow-x-auto">
            <table class="w-full">
                <thead class="bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-200">
                    <tr>
                        <th class="px-6 py-4 text-left text-sm font-bold text-gray-600">Reported Post</th>
                        <th class="px-6 py-4 text-left text-sm font-bold text-gray-600">Reporter</th>
                        <th class="px-6 py-4 text-left text-sm font-bold text-gray-600">Reason</th>
                        <th class="px-6 py-4 text-left text-sm font-bold text-gray-600">Date</th>
                        <th class="px-6 py-4 text-left text-sm font-bold text-gray-600">Status</th>
                        <th class="px-6 py-4 text-left text-sm font-bold text-gray-600">Actions</th>
                    </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody class="divide-y divide-slate-100">
                    @if (Model.Reports.Any())
                    {
                        @foreach (var report in Model.Reports)
                        {
                            <tr class="hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors" data-report-id="@report.Id">
                                <td class="px-6 py-4">
                                    <a asp-controller="Posts" asp-action="Details" asp-route-id="@report.PostId" class="text-sm text-blue-600 hover:underline">
                                        Post @report.PostId.ToString().Substring(0, 8)...
                                    </a>
                                </td>
                                <td class="px-6 py-4">
                                    <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                                        <img src="https://ui-avatars.com/api/?name=@report.ReporterName&background=345e69&color=fff"
                                             class="w-6 h-6 rounded-full" />
                                        <span class="text-sm text-gray-600">@report.ReporterName</span>
                                    </div>
                                </td>
                                <td class="px-6 py-4">
                                    <span class="px-3 py-1 bg-red-50 text-red-700 text-xs font-bold rounded-full">
                                        @report.Reason
                                    </span>
                                </td>
                                <td class="px-6 py-4 text-sm text-gray-600">@report.ReportedAt.ToString("MMM dd, yyyy HH:mm")</td>
                                <td class="px-6 py-4">
                                    @if (report.IsResolved)
                                    {
                                        <span class="px-3 py-1 bg-green-100 text-green-700 text-xs font-bold rounded-full">Resolved</span>
                                    }
                                    else
                                    {
                                        <span class="px-3 py-1 bg-red-100 text-red-700 text-xs font-bold rounded-full">Pending</span>
                                    }
                                </td>
                                <td class="px-6 py-4">
                                    <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                                        @if (!report.IsResolved)
                                        {
                                            <button onclick="resolveReport('@report.Id')" class="p-2 text-green-600 hover:bg-green-50 rounded-xl transition-colors" title="Resolve">
                                                <svg class="w-5 h-5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                                                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M5 13l4 4L19 7" />
                                                </svg>
                                            </button>
                                            <button onclick="dismissReport('@report.Id')" class="p-2 text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-50 rounded-xl transition-colors" title="Dismiss">
                                                <svg class="w-5 h-5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                                                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12" />
                                                </svg>
                                            </button>
                                            <button onclick="deleteReportedPost('@report.PostId', '@report.Id')" class="p-2 text-red-600 hover:bg-red-50 rounded-xl transition-colors" title="Delete Post">
                                                <svg class="w-5 h-5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                                                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M19 7l-.867 12.142A2 2 0 0116.138 21H7.862a2 2 0 01-1.995-1.858L5 7m5 4v6m4-6v6m1-10V4a1 1 0 00-1-1h-4a1 1 0 00-1 1v3M4 7h16" />
                                                </svg>
                                            </button>
                                        }
                                        else
                                        {
                                            <span class="text-xs text-gray-400">No actions</span>
                                        }
                                    </div>
                                </td>
                            </tr>
                        }
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        <tr>
                            <td colspan="6" class="px-6 py-12 text-center text-gray-500">
                                No reports found
                            </td>
                        </tr>
                    }
                </tbody>
            </table>
        </div>

        <!-- Pagination -->
        @if (Model.TotalCount > Model.PageSize)
        {
            <div class="px-6 py-4 border-t border-slate-100 flex items-center justify-between">
                <div class="text-sm text-gray-500">
                    Showing @(((Model.CurrentPage - 1) * Model.PageSize) + 1) to @(Math.Min(Model.CurrentPage * Model.PageSize, Model.TotalCount)) of @Model.TotalCount reports
                </div>
                <div class="flex gap-2">
                    @if (Model.CurrentPage > 1)
                    {
                        <a asp-action="Reports" asp-route-page="@(Model.CurrentPage - 1)" asp-route-status="@Model.StatusFilter"
                           class="px-4 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors">
                            Previous
                        </a>
                    }
                    @if (Model.CurrentPage < (int)Math.Ceiling((double)Model.TotalCount / Model.PageSize))
                    {
                        <a asp-action="Reports" asp-route-page="@(Model.CurrentPage + 1)" asp-route-status="@Model.StatusFilter"
                           class="px-4 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors">
                            Next
                        </a>
                    }
                </div>
            </div>
        }
    </div>
</div>

@section Scripts {
    <script src="~/js/features/dashboard.js" asp-append-version="true"></script>
    <script>
        document.getElementById('statusFilter').addEventListener('change', function() {
            applyFilters();
        });

        function applyFilters() {
            const status = document.getElementById('statusFilter').value;
            window.location.href = `/Dashboard/Reports?status=${status}`;
        }

        function resolveReport(reportId) {
            showConfirmModal({
            title: 'Resolve Report',
            message: 'Mark this report as resolved?',
            type: 'info',
            confirmText: 'Resolve',
            onConfirm: async function () {
                const result = await SohbaApp.post('/Dashboard/ResolveReport', { reportId });
                if (result.success) {
                    SohbaApp.toast('Report resolved', 'success');
                    location.reload();
                } else {
                SohbaApp.toast(result.error || 'Failed to resolve report', 'error');
                }
            }
        });
 }

        function dismissReport(reportId) {
             showConfirmModal({
                 title: 'Dismiss Report',
                 message: 'Dismiss this report?',
                 type: 'warning',
                 confirmText: 'Dismiss',
                 onConfirm: async function () {
                     const result = await SohbaApp.post('/Dashboard/DismissReport', { reportId });
                     if (result.success) {
                         SohbaApp.toast('Report dismissed', 'success');
                         location.reload();
                     } else {
                         SohbaApp.toast(result.error || 'Failed to dismiss report', 'error');
                     }
                 }
             });
         }


        function deleteReportedPost(postId, reportId) {
             showConfirmModal({
                 title: 'Delete Post',
                 message: 'Are you sure you want to delete this post? This action cannot be undone.',
                 type: 'delete',
                 confirmText: 'Delete',
                 onConfirm: async function () {
                     const result = await SohbaApp.post('/Dashboard/DeleteReportedPost', { postId, reportId });
                     if (result.success) {
                         SohbaApp.toast('Post deleted and report resolved', 'success');
                         location.reload();
                     } else {
                         SohbaApp.toast(result.error || 'Failed to delete post', 'error');
                     }
                 }
             });
         }
    </script>
}
</file>

<file path="Sohba/Views/Friends/Find.cshtml">
@model IEnumerable<Sohba.Application.DTOs.UserAggregate.UserResponseDto>
@{
    ViewData["Title"] = "Find Friends";
    Layout = "_AppLayout";
}

<div class="max-w-7xl mx-auto page-transition">
    <!-- Header -->
    <div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-100 p-6 mb-6">
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
            <div>
                <h1 class="text-2xl font-black text-gray-900">Find Friends</h1>
                <p class="text-gray-500 mt-1">Search and connect with people</p>
            </div>
            <a asp-action="Index" class="px-4 py-2 bg-slate-100 text-gray-700 font-semibold rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-200 transition-colors">
                Back to Friends
            </a>
        </div>

        <!-- Search Bar -->
        <div class="mt-4 relative">
            <span class="absolute left-4 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-gray-400">
                <svg class="w-5 h-5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M21 21l-6-6m2-5a7 7 0 11-14 0 7 7 0 0114 0z" />
                </svg>
            </span>
            <input type="text" id="friendsSearchInput" placeholder="Search by name..."
                   class="w-full pl-12 pr-4 py-3 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#345e69]/20 focus:border-[#345e69] transition-all" />
        </div>

        <!-- Filter Buttons -->
        <div class="flex gap-2 mt-4">
            <button onclick="filterUsers('all')" class="filter-btn active px-4 py-2 bg-[#345e69] text-white text-sm font-semibold rounded-xl hover:bg-[#2a4b55] transition-colors">
                All
            </button>
            <button onclick="filterUsers('mutual')" class="filter-btn px-4 py-2 bg-slate-100 text-gray-700 text-sm font-semibold rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-200 transition-colors">
                Mutual Friends
            </button>
            <button onclick="filterUsers('recent')" class="filter-btn px-4 py-2 bg-slate-100 text-gray-700 text-sm font-semibold rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-200 transition-colors">
                Recently Joined
            </button>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Users Grid -->
    <div id="usersContainer" class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
        @if (Model != null && Model.Any())
        {
            @foreach (var user in Model)
            {
                <div class="user-card bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-100 p-5 hover-lift" data-user-id="@user.Id" data-name="@user.Name.ToLower()">
                    <div class="flex items-center gap-4">
                        <div class="relative">
                            <img src="@(user.ProfilePictureUrl ?? $"https://ui-avatars.com/api/?name={user.Name}&background=345e69&color=fff")"
                                 class="w-16 h-16 rounded-2xl object-cover border-2 border-slate-100" />
                            <span class="absolute -bottom-1 -right-1 w-4 h-4 bg-green-500 rounded-full border-2 border-white"></span>
                        </div>
                        <div class="flex-1 min-w-0">
                            <h3 class="font-bold text-gray-900 truncate">@user.Name</h3>
                            <p class="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1">@user.Bio</p>
                            <p class="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-1">Joined @user.CreatedAt.ToString("MMM yyyy")</p>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="flex gap-2 mt-4">
                        <button onclick="sendFriendRequest('@user.Id')"
                                class="flex-1 py-2 bg-[#345e69] text-white font-semibold rounded-xl hover:bg-[#2a4b55] transition-colors">
                            Add Friend
                        </button>
                        <button onclick="viewProfile('@user.Id')"
                                class="p-2 text-gray-400 hover:text-[#345e69] hover:bg-slate-50 rounded-xl transition-colors">
                            <svg class="w-5 h-5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M15 12a3 3 0 11-6 0 3 3 0 016 0z" />
                                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M2.458 12C3.732 7.943 7.523 5 12 5c4.478 0 8.268 2.943 9.542 7-1.274 4.057-5.064 7-9.542 7-4.477 0-8.268-2.943-9.542-7z" />
                            </svg>
                        </button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            }
        }
    </div>

    <!-- No Results Message (hidden by default) -->
    <div id="noResultsMessage" class="hidden text-center py-20 bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-100">
        <div class="bg-slate-50 w-24 h-24 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-4">
            <svg class="w-12 h-12 text-slate-300" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M21 21l-6-6m2-5a7 7 0 11-14 0 7 7 0 0114 0z" />
            </svg>
        </div>
        <h3 class="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900">No users found</h3>
        <p class="text-gray-500 mt-2">Try searching with a different name</p>
    </div>
</div>

@section Scripts {
    <script src="~/js/features/friends.js"></script>
}
</file>

<file path="Sohba/Views/Groups/Create.cshtml">
@model Sohba.ViewModels.Group.GroupCreateViewModel
@{
    ViewData["Title"] = "Create Group";
    Layout = "_AppLayout";
}

<div class="max-w-7xl mx-auto page-transition">
    <div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-100 overflow-hidden hover-lift">
        <div class="bg-gradient-to-br from-[#345e69] via-[#407380] to-[#4a8291] p-8 text-white relative overflow-hidden">
            <div class="absolute top-0 right-0 -mt-4 -mr-4 w-32 h-32 bg-white/10 rounded-full blur-3xl"></div>
            <div class="absolute bottom-0 left-10 w-24 h-24 bg-black/5 rounded-full blur-2xl"></div>

            <div class="relative z-10">
                <div class="flex items-center gap-4">
                    <div class="p-3 bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-xl shadow-black/10 transition-transform hover:scale-105 duration-300">
                        <svg class="w-8 h-8 text-[#345e69]" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M17 20h5v-2a3 3 0 00-5.356-1.857M17 20H7m10 0v-2c0-.656-.126-1.283-.356-1.857M7 20H2v-2a3 3 0 015.356-1.857M7 20v-2c0-.656.126-1.283.356-1.857m0 0a5.002 5.002 0 019.288 0M15 7a3 3 0 11-6 0 3 3 0 016 0zm6 3a2 2 0 11-4 0 2 2 0 014 0zM7 10a2 2 0 11-4 0 2 2 0 014 0z" />
                        </svg>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                        <h1 class="text-3xl font-black text-white tracking-tight">Create New Group</h1>
                        <p class="text-white/80 mt-1 font-medium italic opacity-90">Build your community and connect with people.</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <form asp-action="Create" method="post" enctype="multipart/form-data" class="p-6 space-y-6">
            @Html.AntiForgeryToken()
            <div asp-validation-summary="ModelOnly" class="text-red-500 text-sm"></div>

            <div>
                <label class="block text-sm font-bold text-gray-700 mb-2">Group Name</label>
                <input asp-for="Name"
                       class="w-full px-4 py-3 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#345e69]/20 focus:border-[#345e69] transition-all"
                       placeholder="Enter group name..." />
            </div>

            <div>
                <label class="block text-sm font-bold text-gray-700 mb-2">Description</label>
                <textarea asp-for="Description" rows="4"
                          class="w-full px-4 py-3 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#345e69]/20 focus:border-[#345e69] transition-all resize-none"
                          placeholder="What's this group about?"></textarea>
            </div>

            <div>
                <label class="block text-sm font-bold text-gray-700 mb-2">Group Image</label>
                <input asp-for="ImageFile" type="file" accept="image/*"
                        id="groupImageInput"
                       class="w-full px-4 py-3 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#345e69]/20 focus:border-[#345e69] transition-all file:mr-4 file:py-2 file:px-4 file:rounded-full file:border-0 file:text-sm file:font-semibold file:bg-emerald-50 file:text-emerald-700 hover:file:bg-emerald-100 cursor-pointer" />
                <p class="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-2">Optional. PNG, JPG up to 5MB.</p>
                <div id="groupImagePreviewContainer" class="hidden mt-3">
                        <img id="groupImagePreview" class="w-32 h-32 rounded-xl object-cover border border-slate-200" />
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="flex gap-3 pt-4 border-t border-slate-100">
                <a asp-action="Index" class="flex-1 py-2.5 border border-gray-200 text-gray-600 font-semibold rounded-xl hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors text-center">
                    Cancel
                </a>
                <button type="submit" class="flex-1 py-2.5 bg-[#345e69] hover:bg-[#2a4b55] text-white font-semibold rounded-xl shadow-lg shadow-[#345e69]/30 transform active:scale-95 transition-all">
                    Create Group
                </button>
            </div>
        </form>
    </div>
</div>


@section Scripts {
    <script>
        document.getElementById('groupImageInput')?.addEventListener('change', function (e) {
            const file = e.target.files[0];
            if (!file) return;
            if (file.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024) {
            alert('Image must be smaller than 5MB');
                e.target.value = '';
                return;
            }
            const reader = new FileReader();
            reader.onload = function (ev) {
                document.getElementById('groupImagePreview').src = ev.target.result;
                document.getElementById('groupImagePreviewContainer').classList.remove('hidden');
            };
            reader.readAsDataURL(file);
        });
    </script>
    
}
</file>

<file path="Sohba/Views/Groups/Index.cshtml">
@model IEnumerable<Sohba.Application.DTOs.GroupAndPageAggregate.GroupResponseDto>
@{
    ViewData["Title"] = "Groups";
    Layout = "_AppLayout";
}

<div class="max-w-7xl mx-auto page-transition">
    <!-- Header -->
    <div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-100 p-6 mb-6 ">
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
            <div>
                <h1 class="text-2xl font-black text-gray-900">Groups</h1>
                <p class="text-gray-500 mt-1">Discover communities</p>
            </div>
            <a asp-action="Create" class="px-4 py-2 bg-[#345e69] text-white font-semibold rounded-xl hover:bg-[#2a4b55] transition-colors flex items-center gap-2">
                <svg class="w-5 h-5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M12 4v16m8-8H4" />
                </svg>
                Create Group
            </a>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Groups List -->
    <div class="space-y-4">
        @foreach (var group in Model)
        {
            <div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-100 p-5 hover-lift flex items-center gap-5 transition-all duration-300">
                <a asp-action="Details" asp-route-id="@group.Id" class="relative group/icon">
                        @*TODO : ADD Image To Group Entity*@
                        @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(group.ImageUrl))
                        {
                            <img src="@group.ImageUrl" class="w-16 h-16 rounded-2xl object-cover shadow-md border border-slate-100 transform transition-transform group-hover/icon:scale-105" alt="@group.Name" />
                        }
                        else
                        { 
                            <div class="w-16 h-16 bg-slate-100 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center relative overflow-hidden shadow-sm border border-slate-200 transform transition-transform group-hover/icon:scale-105">
                                <span class="relative z-10 text-[#345e69] text-2xl font-black tracking-tighter">
                                    @group.Name[0].ToString().ToUpper()
                                </span>

                                <div class="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-br from-white/40 to-transparent pointer-events-none"></div>
                            </div>
                         } 

                        @if (group.IsCurrentUserMember)
                        {
                            <div class="absolute -top-1 -right-1 w-4 h-4 bg-green-500 border-2 border-white rounded-full shadow-sm z-20"></div>
                        }
                </a>
                

                <div class="flex-1">
                    <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <a asp-action="Details" asp-route-id="@group.Id" class="font-black text-gray-800 text-lg leading-tight hover:underline">@group.Name</a>
                        @if (group.IsCurrentUserMember)
                        {
                            <svg class="w-5 h-5 text-blue-500" fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 20 20">
                                <path d="M6.267 3.455a3.066 3.066 0 001.745-.723 3.066 3.066 0 013.976 0 3.066 3.066 0 001.745.723 3.066 3.066 0 012.812 2.812c.051.643.304 1.254.723 1.745a3.066 3.066 0 010 3.976 3.066 3.066 0 00-.723 1.745 3.066 3.066 0 01-2.812 2.812 3.066 3.066 0 00-1.745.723 3.066 3.066 0 01-3.976 0 3.066 3.066 0 00-1.745-.723 3.066 3.066 0 01-2.812-2.812 3.066 3.066 0 00-.723-1.745 3.066 3.066 0 010-3.976 3.066 3.066 0 00.723-1.745 3.066 3.066 0 012.812-2.812zm7.44 5.252a1 1 0 00-1.414-1.414L9 10.586 7.707 9.293a1 1 0 00-1.414 1.414l2 2a1 1 0 001.414 0l4-4z" />
                            </svg>
                        }
                    </div>
                    <p class="text-gray-500 text-sm line-clamp-1 mt-0.5">@group.Description</p>

                    <div class="flex items-center gap-3 mt-3">
                        <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-slate-50 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg border border-slate-100">
                            <svg class="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M12 4.354a4 4 0 110 5.292M15 21H3v-1a6 6 0 0112 0v1zm0 0h6v-1a6 6 0 00-9-5.197M13 7a4 4 0 11-8 0 4 4 0 018 0z" /></svg>
                            <span class="text-xs font-bold text-slate-600">@group.MembersCount</span>
                        </div>
                        <span class="text-slate-300">•</span>
                        <span class="text-xs font-medium text-slate-400">Admin: <span class="text-[#345e69] font-bold">@group.AdminName</span></span>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="flex items-center">
                    @if (group.IsCurrentUserMember)
                    {
                        <a asp-action="Details" asp-route-id="@group.Id" class="px-6 py-2.5 bg-green-50 text-green-700 font-bold rounded-xl hover:bg-green-100 transition-all border border-green-100">
                            View Group
                        </a>
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        <button onclick="joinGroup('@group.Id', this)" class="px-6 py-2.5 bg-[#345e69] text-white font-bold rounded-xl hover:bg-[#2a4b55] shadow-md shadow-[#345e69]/20 transition-all active:scale-95">
                            Join
                        </button>
                    }
                </div>
            </div>
        }
    </div>

    @if (!Model.Any())
    {
        <div class="text-center py-20">
            <div class="bg-slate-50 w-24 h-24 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-4">
                <svg class="w-12 h-12 text-slate-300" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M17 20h5v-2a3 3 0 00-5.356-1.857M17 20H7m10 0v-2c0-.656-.126-1.283-.356-1.857M7 20H2v-2a3 3 0 015.356-1.857M7 20v-2c0-.656.126-1.283.356-1.857m0 0a5.002 5.002 0 019.288 0M15 7a3 3 0 11-6 0 3 3 0 016 0zm6 3a2 2 0 11-4 0 2 2 0 014 0zM7 10a2 2 0 11-4 0 2 2 0 014 0z" />
                </svg>
            </div>
            <h3 class="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900">No groups yet</h3>
            <p class="text-gray-500 mt-2">Create or join a group!</p>
        </div>
    }
</div>

@section Scripts {
    <script>
        async function joinGroup(groupId, button) {
            const result = await SohbaApp.post('/Groups/Join', { id: groupId });
            if (result.success) {
                SohbaApp.toast('Joined group successfully!', 'success');
                // Update button UI
                button.outerHTML = '<span class="px-6 py-2 bg-green-100 text-green-700 font-semibold rounded-xl">Member</span>';
            } else {
                SohbaApp.toast(result.error || 'Failed to join', 'error');
            }
        }
    </script>
}
</file>

<file path="Sohba/Views/Pages/Create.cshtml">
@model Sohba.ViewModels.Page.PageCreateViewModel
@{
    ViewData["Title"] = "Create Page";
    Layout = "_AppLayout";
}

<div class="max-w-7xl mx-auto page-transition">
    <div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-100 overflow-hidden hover-lift">
        <div class="bg-gradient-to-br from-[#345e69] via-[#407380] to-[#4a8291] p-8 text-white relative overflow-hidden">
            <div class="absolute top-0 right-0 -mt-4 -mr-4 w-32 h-32 bg-white/10 rounded-full blur-3xl"></div>
            <div class="absolute bottom-0 left-10 w-24 h-24 bg-black/5 rounded-full blur-2xl"></div>

            <div class="relative z-10">
                <div class="flex items-center gap-4">
                    <div class="p-3 bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-xl shadow-black/10 transition-transform hover:scale-105 duration-300">
                        <svg class="w-8 h-8 text-[#345e69]" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M19 20H5a2 2 0 01-2-2V6a2 2 0 012-2h10a2 2 0 012 2v1m2 13a2 2 0 01-2-2V7m2 13a2 2 0 002-2V9a2 2 0 00-2-2h-2m-4-3H9M7 16h6M7 8h6v4H7V8z" />
                        </svg>
                    </div>

                    <div>
                        <h1 class="text-3xl font-black text-white tracking-tight">
                            Create New Page
                        </h1>
                        <p class="text-white/80 mt-1 font-medium italic opacity-90">
                            Share your passion with the world.
                        </p>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <form asp-action="Create" method="post" enctype="multipart/form-data" class="p-6 space-y-6">
            @Html.AntiForgeryToken()
            <div asp-validation-summary="ModelOnly" class="text-red-500 text-sm"></div>

            <div>
                <label class="block text-sm font-bold text-gray-700 mb-2">Page Name</label>
                <input asp-for="Name"
                       class="w-full px-4 py-3 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#345e69]/20 focus:border-[#345e69] transition-all"
                       placeholder="Enter page name..." />
            </div>

            <div>
                <label class="block text-sm font-bold text-gray-700 mb-2">Description</label>
                <textarea asp-for="Description" rows="4"
                          class="w-full px-4 py-3 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#345e69]/20 focus:border-[#345e69] transition-all resize-none"
                          placeholder="What is this page about?"></textarea>
            </div>

            <div>
                <label class="block text-sm font-bold text-gray-700 mb-2">Page Image</label>
                <input asp-for="ImageFile" type="file" accept="image/*"
                       class="w-full px-4 py-3 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#345e69]/20 focus:border-[#345e69] transition-all file:mr-4 file:py-2 file:px-4 file:rounded-full file:border-0 file:text-sm file:font-semibold file:bg-[#345e69]/10 file:text-[#345e69] hover:file:bg-[#345e69]/20 cursor-pointer" />
                <p class="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-2">Optional. PNG, JPG up to 5MB.</p>
                <div id="pageImagePreviewContainer" class="hidden mt-3">
                    <img id="pageImagePreview" class="w-32 h-32 rounded-xl object-cover border border-slate-200" />
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="flex gap-3 pt-4 border-t border-slate-100">
                <a asp-action="Index" class="flex-1 py-2.5 border border-gray-200 text-gray-600 font-semibold rounded-xl hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors text-center">
                    Cancel
                </a>
                <button type="submit" class="flex-1 py-2.5 bg-[#345e69] hover:bg-[#2a4b55] text-white font-semibold rounded-xl shadow-lg shadow-[#345e69]/30 transform active:scale-95 transition-all">
                    Create Page
                </button>
            </div>
        </form>
    </div>
</div>

@section Scripts {
    <script>
        document.getElementById('ImageFile')?.addEventListener('change', function (e) {
            const file = e.target.files[0];
            if (!file) return;
            if (file.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024) {
                window.SohbaApp.toast('Image must be smaller than 5MB', 'error');
                e.target.value = '';
                return;
            }
            const reader = new FileReader();
            reader.onload = function (ev) {
                document.getElementById('pageImagePreview').src = ev.target.result;
                document.getElementById('pageImagePreviewContainer').classList.remove('hidden');
            };
            reader.readAsDataURL(file);
        });
    </script>
}
</file>

<file path="Sohba/Views/Posts/Favorites.cshtml">
@model IEnumerable<Sohba.Application.DTOs.PostAggregate.PostResponseDto>
@{
    ViewData["Title"] = "Favorites";
    Layout = "_AppLayout";
}

<div class="max-w-5xl mx-auto page-transition">
    <!-- Header -->
    <div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-100 p-6 mb-6">
        <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div class="w-12 h-12 bg-pink-100 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center">
                <svg class="w-6 h-6 text-pink-500" fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 20 20">
                    <path fill-rule="evenodd" d="M3.172 5.172a4 4 0 015.656 0L10 6.343l1.172-1.171a4 4 0 115.656 5.656L10 17.657l-6.828-6.829a4 4 0 010-5.656z" clip-rule="evenodd" />
                </svg>
            </div>
            <div>
                <h1 class="text-2xl font-black text-gray-900">Favorites</h1>
                <p class="text-gray-500 mt-1">@Model.Count() favorite posts</p>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Favorites Grid -->
    @if (Model != null && Model.Any())
    {
        <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            @foreach (var post in Model)
            {
                <div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-100 overflow-hidden hover-lift group" data-post-id="@post.Id">
                    @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(post.ImageUrl))
                    {
                        <div class="h-48 overflow-hidden">
                            <img src="@post.ImageUrl" class="w-full h-full object-cover group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform duration-300" />
                        </div>
                    }

                    <div class="p-5">
                        <div class="flex items-start justify-between">
                            <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                                <span class="px-3 py-1 bg-pink-100 text-pink-600 text-xs font-bold rounded-full">⭐ Favorite</span>
                            </div>

                            <button onclick="removeFromFavorites('@post.Id')"
                                    class="text-gray-400 hover:text-pink-500 p-2 hover:bg-pink-50 rounded-xl transition-colors"
                                    title="Remove from favorites">
                                <svg class="w-5 h-5" fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 20 20">
                                    <path fill-rule="evenodd" d="M3.172 5.172a4 4 0 015.656 0L10 6.343l1.172-1.171a4 4 0 115.656 5.656L10 17.657l-6.828-6.829a4 4 0 010-5.656z" clip-rule="evenodd" />
                                </svg>
                            </button>
                        </div>

                        <h3 class="font-bold text-gray-900 mt-3 text-lg">@post.Title</h3>

                        <p class="text-sm text-gray-600 mt-2 line-clamp-2">@post.Content</p>

                        <div class="flex items-center gap-2 mt-4 text-xs text-gray-500">
                            <svg class="w-4 h-4" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M12 8v4l3 3m6-3a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z" />
                            </svg>
                            <span>Favorited @post.CreatedAt.ToString("MMM dd, yyyy")</span>
                        </div>

                        <div class="flex items-center justify-between mt-4">
                            <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                                <img src="https://ui-avatars.com/api/?name=@post.AuthorName&background=345e69&color=fff" class="w-6 h-6 rounded-full" />
                                <span class="text-xs text-gray-600">@post.AuthorName</span>
                            </div>

                            <a asp-controller="Posts" asp-action="Details" asp-route-id="@post.Id"
                               class="text-sm text-[#345e69] font-semibold hover:underline">
                                View Post →
                            </a>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            }
        </div>
    }
    else
    {
        <div class="text-center py-20">
            <div class="bg-slate-50 w-24 h-24 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-4">
                <svg class="w-12 h-12 text-slate-300" fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 20 20">
                    <path fill-rule="evenodd" d="M3.172 5.172a4 4 0 015.656 0L10 6.343l1.172-1.171a4 4 0 115.656 5.656L10 17.657l-6.828-6.829a4 4 0 010-5.656z" clip-rule="evenodd" />
                </svg>
            </div>
            <h3 class="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900">No favorites yet</h3>
            <p class="text-gray-500 mt-2">Posts you mark as favorite will appear here</p>
            <a asp-controller="Home" asp-action="Index" class="inline-block mt-4 px-6 py-2 bg-[#345e69] text-white font-semibold rounded-xl hover:bg-[#2a4b55] transition-colors">
                Browse Feed
            </a>
        </div>
    }
</div>

@section Scripts {
    <script>
        async function removeFromFavorites(postId) {
            if (!confirm('Remove from favorites?')) return;

            const result = await SohbaApp.post('/Posts/ToggleFavorite', { postId });

            if (result.success) {
                SohbaApp.toast('Removed from favorites', 'success');
                document.querySelector(`[data-post-id="${postId}"]`).remove();

                const remainingCount = document.querySelectorAll('[data-post-id]').length;
                document.querySelector('.text-gray-500.mt-1').textContent = `${remainingCount} favorite posts`;
            }
        }
    </script>
}
</file>

<file path="Sohba/Views/Search/Results.cshtml">
@model Sohba.ViewModels.Search.SearchViewModel
@{
    ViewData["Title"] = $"Search results for \"{Model.Query}\"";
    Layout = "_AppLayout";
}

<div class="max-w-6xl mx-auto page-transition">
    <!-- Header -->
    <div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-100 p-6 mb-6">
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
            <div>
                <h1 class="text-2xl font-black text-gray-900">Search Results</h1>
                <p class="text-gray-500 mt-1">
                    @Model.Results.TotalCount results for "@Model.Query"
                </p>
            </div>
            <div class="relative w-64">
                <input type="text" 
                       id="refineSearchInput"
                       value="@Model.Query"
                       class="w-full pl-10 pr-4 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#345e69]/20"
                       placeholder="Refine search..."
                       onkeypress="if(event.key === 'Enter') refineSearch()" />
                <span class="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-gray-400">
                    <svg class="w-4 h-4" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M21 21l-6-6m2-5a7 7 0 11-14 0 7 7 0 0114 0z" />
                    </svg>
                </span>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Tabs -->
        <div class="flex gap-2 mt-6 border-b border-slate-100">
            <button onclick="switchTab('all')" 
                    class="tab-btn px-4 py-2 text-sm font-bold @(Model.ActiveTab == "all" ? "text-[#345e69] border-b-2 border-[#345e69]" : "text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600")">
                All (@Model.Results.TotalCount)
            </button>
            <button onclick="switchTab('posts')" 
                    class="tab-btn px-4 py-2 text-sm font-bold @(Model.ActiveTab == "posts" ? "text-[#345e69] border-b-2 border-[#345e69]" : "text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600")">
                Posts (@Model.Results.Posts.Count)
            </button>
            <button onclick="switchTab('people')" 
                    class="tab-btn px-4 py-2 text-sm font-bold @(Model.ActiveTab == "people" ? "text-[#345e69] border-b-2 border-[#345e69]" : "text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600")">
                People (@Model.Results.Users.Count)
            </button>
            <button onclick="switchTab('groups')" 
                    class="tab-btn px-4 py-2 text-sm font-bold @(Model.ActiveTab == "groups" ? "text-[#345e69] border-b-2 border-[#345e69]" : "text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600")">
                Groups (@Model.Results.Groups.Count)
            </button>
            <button onclick="switchTab('pages')" 
                    class="tab-btn px-4 py-2 text-sm font-bold @(Model.ActiveTab == "pages" ? "text-[#345e69] border-b-2 border-[#345e69]" : "text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600")">
                Pages (@Model.Results.Pages.Count)
            </button>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- All Results Tab -->
    <div id="tab-all" class="tab-content @(Model.ActiveTab == "all" ? "" : "hidden")">
        @if (Model.Results.TotalCount == 0)
        {
            <div class="text-center py-20 bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-100">
                <div class="bg-slate-50 w-24 h-24 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-4">
                    <svg class="w-12 h-12 text-slate-300" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M21 21l-6-6m2-5a7 7 0 11-14 0 7 7 0 0114 0z" />
                    </svg>
                </div>
                <h3 class="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900">No results found</h3>
                <p class="text-gray-500 mt-2">Try searching with different keywords</p>
            </div>
        }
        else
        {
            <div class="space-y-8">
                <!-- People Section -->
                @if (Model.Results.Users.Any())
                {
                    <div class="bg-white rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-sm border border-slate-100">
                        <h2 class="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900 mb-4">People</h2>
                        <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                            @foreach (var user in Model.Results.Users.Take(4))
                            {
                                <a href="@user.Url" class="flex items-center gap-3 p-3 hover:bg-slate-50 rounded-xl transition-colors">
                                    <img src="@(user.ProfilePictureUrl ?? $"https://ui-avatars.com/api/?name={user.Name}&background=345e69&color=fff")" 
                                         class="w-12 h-12 rounded-full object-cover" />
                                    <div>
                                        <h3 class="font-semibold text-gray-900">@user.Name</h3>
                                        <p class="text-sm text-gray-500">@(user.Bio ?? "User")</p>
                                    </div>
                                </a>
                            }
                        </div>
                        @if (Model.Results.Users.Count > 4)
                        {
                            <button onclick="switchTab('people')" class="mt-4 text-sm text-[#345e69] font-semibold hover:underline">
                                See all @Model.Results.Users.Count people →
                            </button>
                        }
                    </div>
                }

                <!-- Posts Section -->
                @if (Model.Results.Posts.Any())
                {
                    <div class="bg-white rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-sm border border-slate-100">
                        <h2 class="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900 mb-4">Posts</h2>
                        <div class="space-y-4">
                            @foreach (var post in Model.Results.Posts.Take(3))
                            {
                                <a href="@post.Url" class="flex items-start gap-4 p-3 hover:bg-slate-50 rounded-xl transition-colors">
                                    @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(post.ImageUrl))
                                    {
                                        <img src="@post.ImageUrl" class="w-16 h-16 rounded-lg object-cover" />
                                    }
                                    else
                                    {
                                        <div class="w-16 h-16 bg-slate-100 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center text-slate-400">
                                            📝
                                        </div>
                                    }
                                    <div class="flex-1">
                                        <h3 class="font-semibold text-gray-900">@post.Title</h3>
                                        <p class="text-sm text-gray-600 line-clamp-2">@post.Content</p>
                                        <p class="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-1">@post.AuthorName · @post.CreatedAt.ToString("MMM dd")</p>
                                    </div>
                                </a>
                            }
                        </div>
                        @if (Model.Results.Posts.Count > 3)
                        {
                            <button onclick="switchTab('posts')" class="mt-4 text-sm text-[#345e69] font-semibold hover:underline">
                                See all @Model.Results.Posts.Count posts →
                            </button>
                        }
                    </div>
                }

                <!-- Groups Section -->
                @if (Model.Results.Groups.Any())
                {
                    <div class="bg-white rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-sm border border-slate-100">
                        <h2 class="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900 mb-4">Groups</h2>
                        <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                            @foreach (var group in Model.Results.Groups.Take(4))
                            {
                                <a href="@group.Url" class="flex items-center gap-3 p-3 hover:bg-slate-50 rounded-xl transition-colors">
                                    @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(group.ImageUrl))
                                    {
                                        <img src="@group.ImageUrl" class="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl object-cover" />
                                    }
                                    else
                                    {
                                        <div class="w-12 h-12 bg-slate-200 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center text-[#345e69] font-bold">
                                            @group.Name[0]
                                        </div>
                                    }
                                    <div>
                                        <h3 class="font-semibold text-gray-900">@group.Name</h3>
                                        <p class="text-xs text-gray-500">@group.MembersCount members</p>
                                    </div>
                                </a>
                            }
                        </div>
                        @if (Model.Results.Groups.Count > 4)
                        {
                            <button onclick="switchTab('groups')" class="mt-4 text-sm text-[#345e69] font-semibold hover:underline">
                                See all @Model.Results.Groups.Count groups →
                            </button>
                        }
                    </div>
                }

                <!-- Pages Section -->
                @if (Model.Results.Pages.Any())
                {
                    <div class="bg-white rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-sm border border-slate-100">
                        <h2 class="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900 mb-4">Pages</h2>
                        <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                            @foreach (var pageItem in Model.Results.Pages.Take(4))
                            {
                                <a href="@pageItem.Url" class="flex items-center gap-3 p-3 hover:bg-slate-50 rounded-xl transition-colors">
                                    @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(pageItem.ImageUrl))
                                    {
                                        <img src="@pageItem.ImageUrl" class="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl object-cover" />
                                    }
                                    else
                                    {
                                        <div class="w-12 h-12 bg-slate-200 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center text-emerald-600 font-bold">
                                            @pageItem.Name[0]
                                        </div>
                                    }
                                    <div>
                                        <h3 class="font-semibold text-gray-900">@pageItem.Name</h3>
                                    </div>
                                </a>
                            }
                        </div>
                        @if (Model.Results.Pages.Count > 4)
                        {
                            <button onclick="switchTab('pages')" class="mt-4 text-sm text-[#345e69] font-semibold hover:underline">
                                See all @Model.Results.Pages.Count pages →
                            </button>
                        }
                    </div>
                }
            </div>
        }
    </div>

    <!-- Posts Tab -->
    <div id="tab-posts" class="tab-content @(Model.ActiveTab == "posts" ? "" : "hidden")">
        <div class="bg-white rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-sm border border-slate-100">
            <h2 class="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900 mb-4">Posts (@Model.Results.Posts.Count)</h2>
            @if (Model.Results.Posts.Any())
            {
                <div class="space-y-4">
                    @foreach (var post in Model.Results.Posts)
                    {
                        <a href="@post.Url" class="flex items-start gap-4 p-3 hover:bg-slate-50 rounded-xl transition-colors">
                            @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(post.ImageUrl))
                            {
                                <img src="@post.ImageUrl" class="w-20 h-20 rounded-lg object-cover" />
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                <div class="w-20 h-20 bg-slate-100 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center text-slate-400">
                                    📝
                                </div>
                            }
                            <div class="flex-1">
                                <h3 class="font-semibold text-gray-900">@post.Title</h3>
                                <p class="text-sm text-gray-600 line-clamp-2">@post.Content</p>
                                <p class="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-1">@post.AuthorName · @post.CreatedAt.ToString("MMM dd, yyyy")</p>
                            </div>
                        </a>
                    }
                </div>
            }
            else
            {
                <p class="text-center text-gray-500 py-8">No posts found</p>
            }
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- People Tab -->
    <div id="tab-people" class="tab-content @(Model.ActiveTab == "people" ? "" : "hidden")">
        <div class="bg-white rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-sm border border-slate-100">
            <h2 class="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900 mb-4">People (@Model.Results.Users.Count)</h2>
            @if (Model.Results.Users.Any())
            {
                <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                    @foreach (var user in Model.Results.Users)
                    {
                        <a href="@user.Url" class="flex items-center gap-3 p-3 hover:bg-slate-50 rounded-xl transition-colors">
                            <img src="@(user.ProfilePictureUrl ?? $"https://ui-avatars.com/api/?name={user.Name}&background=345e69&color=fff")" 
                                 class="w-12 h-12 rounded-full object-cover" />
                            <div>
                                <h3 class="font-semibold text-gray-900">@user.Name</h3>
                                <p class="text-sm text-gray-500">@(user.Bio ?? "User")</p>
                            </div>
                        </a>
                    }
                </div>
            }
            else
            {
                <p class="text-center text-gray-500 py-8">No people found</p>

        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Groups Tab -->
    <div id="tab-groups" class="tab-content @(Model.ActiveTab == "groups" ? "" : "hidden")">
        <div class="bg-white rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-sm border border-slate-100">
            <h2 class="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900 mb-4">Groups (@Model.Results.Groups.Count)</h2>
            @if (Model.Results.Groups.Any())
            {
                <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                    @foreach (var group in Model.Results.Groups)

                            @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(group.ImageUrl))

                                <img src="@group.ImageUrl" class="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl object-cover" />
                            }
                            else

                                <div class="w-12 h-12 bg-slate-200 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center text-[#345e69] font-bold">
                                    @group.Name[0]

                            <div>
                                <h3 class="font-semibold text-gray-900">@group.Name</h3>
                                <p class="text-xs text-gray-500">@group.MembersCount members</p>
                            </div>
                        </a>
                    }
                </div>
            }
            else
            {
                <p class="text-center text-gray-500 py-8">No groups found</p>
            }
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Pages Tab -->
    <div id="tab-pages" class="tab-content @(Model.ActiveTab == "pages" ? "" : "hidden")">
        <div class="bg-white rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-sm border border-slate-100">
            <h2 class="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900 mb-4">Pages (@Model.Results.Pages.Count)</h2>
            @if (Model.Results.Pages.Any())
            {
                <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                    @foreach (var pageItem in Model.Results.Pages)
                    {
                        <a href="@pageItem.Url" class="flex items-center gap-3 p-3 hover:bg-slate-50 rounded-xl transition-colors">
                            @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(pageItem.ImageUrl))
                            {
                                <img src="@pageItem.ImageUrl" class="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl object-cover" />
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                <div class="w-12 h-12 bg-slate-200 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center text-emerald-600 font-bold">
                                    @pageItem.Name[0]
                                </div>
                            }
                            <div>
                                <h3 class="font-semibold text-gray-900">@pageItem.Name</h3>
                            </div>
                        </a>
                    }
                </div>
            }
            else
            {
                <p class="text-center text-gray-500 py-8">No pages found</p>
            }
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
</file>

<file path="Sohba/Views/Stories/Index.cshtml">
@model IEnumerable<Sohba.Application.DTOs.StoryAggregate.StoryResponseDto>
@{
    ViewData["Title"] = "Stories";
    Layout = "_AppLayout";
}

<div class="max-w-5xl mx-auto page-transition">
    <!-- Create Story -->
    <div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-100 p-6 mb-6 hover-lift cursor-pointer" onclick="openStoryModal()">
        <div class="flex items-center gap-4">
            <div class="w-14 h-14 bg-gradient-to-br from-[#345e69] to-[#4a8291] rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-white">
                <svg class="w-7 h-7" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M12 4v16m8-8H4" />
                </svg>
            </div>
            <div>
                <h3 class="font-bold text-gray-900">Create Story</h3>
                <p class="text-gray-500 text-sm">Share a photo or video that disappears after 24 hours</p>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Stories List -->
    <div class="space-y-4">
        @foreach (var story in Model)
        {
            <div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-100 overflow-hidden hover-lift">
                <div class="relative h-96 bg-slate-900">
                    @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(story.MediaUrl))
                    { 
                        <img src="@story.MediaUrl" class="w-full h-full object-cover" />
                    }
                    <div class="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/60 via-transparent to-transparent"></div>

                    <!-- User Info -->
                    <div class="absolute top-4 left-4 flex items-center gap-3">
                        <div class="w-10 h-10 rounded-full border-2 border-[#345e69] p-0.5 bg-white">
                            <img src="https://ui-avatars.com/api/?name=@story.UserName&background=345e69&color=fff" class="w-full h-full rounded-full" />
                        </div>
                        <span class="text-white font-semibold text-shadow">@story.UserName</span>
                    </div>

                    <!-- Time -->
                    <div class="absolute top-4 right-4">
                        <span class="text-white/80 text-sm bg-black/30 px-3 py-1 rounded-full">
                               @((DateTime.UtcNow - story.CreatedAt).TotalHours.ToString("0"))h ago
                        </span>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="p-4">
                    <p class="text-gray-700">@story.Content</p>
                </div>
            </div>
        }
    </div>

    @if (!Model.Any())
    {
        <div class="text-center py-20">
            <div class="bg-slate-50 w-24 h-24 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-4">
                <svg class="w-12 h-12 text-slate-300" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M4 16l4.586-4.586a2 2 0 012.828 0L16 16m-2-2l1.586-1.586a2 2 0 012.828 0L20 14m-6-6h.01M6 20h12a2 2 0 002-2V6a2 2 0 00-2-2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v12a2 2 0 002 2z" />
                </svg>
            </div>
            <h3 class="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900">No stories yet</h3>
            <p class="text-gray-500 mt-2">Be the first to share a story!</p>
        </div>
    }
</div>

@section Scripts {
    <script>
        function openStoryModal() {
            document.getElementById('storyModal').classList.remove('hidden');
        }
    </script>
}
</file>

<file path="Sohba/wwwroot/js/features/header.js">
// ============================================================
// NOTIFICATION FUNCTIONS
// ============================================================

function getNotificationIcon(type) {
    const icons = {
        'PostLike': '❤️',
        'PostComment': '💬',
        'FriendRequest': '👥',
        'GroupInvitation': '👪',
        'SystemAlert': '🔔',
        'StoryLike': '⭐'
    };
    return icons[type] || '📢';
}

function getNotificationUrl(notif) {
    const type = notif.notificationType;
    const targetId = notif.targetId || '';

    if (type === 'PostLike' || type === 'PostComment') return `/Posts/Details/${targetId}`;
    if (type === 'GroupInvitation') return `/Groups/Details/${targetId}`;
    if (type === 'FriendRequest') return '/Friends/Requests';
    if (type === 'SystemAlert' && targetId) return `/Groups/Details/${targetId}`;
    return '/Notifications/Index'; 
}

async function updateNotificationCount() {
    try {
        const response = await fetch('/Notifications/GetUnreadCount');
        const data = await response.json();

        let badge = document.querySelector('.notif-badge');
        const notifBtn = document.getElementById('notifBtn');

        if (data.count > 0) {
            if (!badge) {
                const newBadge = document.createElement('span');
                newBadge.className = 'notif-badge absolute -top-1 -right-1 bg-red-500 text-white text-xs w-5 h-5 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center font-bold';
                newBadge.textContent = data.count > 99 ? '99+' : data.count;
                notifBtn?.appendChild(newBadge);
            } else {
                badge.textContent = data.count > 99 ? '99+' : data.count;
                badge.classList.remove('hidden');
            }
        } else {
            if (badge) badge.classList.add('hidden');
        }
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error updating notification count:', error);
    }
}

async function loadNotifications() {
    const list = document.getElementById('notifList');
    const badge = document.getElementById('notifCountBadge');

    if (!list) return;

    try {
        const response = await fetch('/Notifications/GetUnreadNotifications');
        const result = await response.json();

        if (result.success && result.data && result.data.length > 0) {
            if (badge) badge.textContent = result.data.length;

            list.innerHTML = result.data.map(notif => `
                <a href="${getNotificationUrl(notif)}"
                   class="flex items-start gap-3 px-4 py-3 hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors border-b border-gray-50 ${notif.isRead ? 'opacity-60' : 'bg-blue-50/30'}">
                    <div class="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-[#345e69]/10 flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0">
                        <span class="text-[#345e69]">${getNotificationIcon(notif.notificationType)}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="flex-1 min-w-0">
                        <p class="text-sm text-gray-800">${notif.message}</p>
                        <p class="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-0.5">${notif.timeAgo}</p>
                    </div>
                    ${!notif.isRead ? `
                        <button onclick="event.preventDefault(); event.stopPropagation(); markNotificationAsRead('${notif.id}')"
                                class="text-xs text-[#345e69] hover:underline self-start mt-1">
                            Mark read
                        </button>
                    ` : ''}
                </a>
            `).join('');
        } else {
            list.innerHTML = '<div class="text-center py-8 text-gray-500 text-sm">No new notifications</div>';
            if (badge) badge.textContent = '0';
        }
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error loading notifications:', error);
        list.innerHTML = '<div class="text-center py-8 text-red-500 text-sm">Failed to load notifications</div>';
    }
}

async function markNotificationAsRead(notificationId) {
    if (!notificationId) return;

    try {
        const token = document.querySelector('input[name="__RequestVerificationToken"]')?.value;
        const response = await fetch(`/Notifications/MarkAsRead?id=${notificationId}`, {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
                'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                'RequestVerificationToken': token
            }
        });
        const result = await response.json();

        if (result.success) {
            await loadNotifications();
            await updateNotificationCount();
            if (typeof SohbaApp !== 'undefined' && SohbaApp.toast) {
                SohbaApp.toast('Notification marked as read', 'success');
            }
        }
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error marking notification as read:', error);
    }
}

async function markAllNotificationsAsRead() {
    try {
        const token = document.querySelector('input[name="__RequestVerificationToken"]')?.value;
        const response = await fetch('/Notifications/MarkAllAsRead', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
                'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                'RequestVerificationToken': token
            }
        });
        const result = await response.json();

        if (result.success) {
            await loadNotifications();
            await updateNotificationCount();
            if (typeof SohbaApp !== 'undefined' && SohbaApp.toast) {
                SohbaApp.toast('All notifications marked as read', 'success');
            }
        }
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error marking all as read:', error);
    }
}

async function deleteNotification(notificationId) {
    if (!notificationId) return;
    if (typeof window.showConfirmModal !== 'function') return;

    window.showConfirmModal({
        title: 'Delete notification',
        message: 'Delete this notification?',
        type: 'delete',
        confirmText: 'Delete',
        onConfirm: async function () {

            try {
                const token = document.querySelector('input[name="__RequestVerificationToken"]')?.value;
                const response = await fetch(`/Notifications/Delete?id=${notificationId}`, {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {
                        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                        'RequestVerificationToken': token
                    }
                });
                const result = await response.json();

                if (result.success) {
                    const item = document.querySelector(`[data-notification-id="${notificationId}"]`);
                    if (item) {
                        item.style.transition = 'opacity 0.3s ease';
                        item.style.opacity = '0';
                        setTimeout(() => item.remove(), 300);
                    }
                    await updateNotificationCount();
                    if (typeof SohbaApp !== 'undefined' && SohbaApp.toast) {
                        SohbaApp.toast('Notification deleted', 'success');
                    }
                }
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Error deleting notification:', error);
                if (typeof SohbaApp !== 'undefined' && SohbaApp.toast) {
                    SohbaApp.toast('Failed to delete notification', 'error');
                }
            }
        }
    });
}

// ============================================================
// SIGNALR NOTIFICATION CONNECTION
// ============================================================

let notificationConnection = null;
let isSignalRConnected = false;

function initializeSignalR() {
    if (isSignalRConnected) return;

    if (!document.getElementById('notifBtn')) {
        console.log('⚠️ Notification elements not found, retrying...');
        setTimeout(initializeSignalR, 500);
        return;
    }

    try {
        const tokenMeta = document.querySelector('meta[name="jwt-token"]');
        const token = tokenMeta?.getAttribute('content');

        if (!token) {
            console.warn('⚠️ No JWT token found, SignalR will not connect');
            return;
        }

        notificationConnection = new signalR.HubConnectionBuilder()
            .withUrl('/notificationHub', {
                accessTokenFactory: () => token
            })
            .withAutomaticReconnect([0, 2000, 5000, 10000, 20000])
            .configureLogging(signalR.LogLevel.Information)
            .build();

        notificationConnection.on('ReceiveNotification', function (notification) {
            console.log('📨 New notification received:', notification);
            handleNotificationReceived(notification);
        });

        notificationConnection.start()
            .then(() => {
                isSignalRConnected = true;
                console.log('✅ SignalR connected for notifications');
            })
            .catch(function (err) {
                console.error('❌ SignalR connection failed:', err);
                isSignalRConnected = false;
                setTimeout(initializeSignalR, 5000);
            });

        notificationConnection.onclose(function () {
            console.log('⚠️ SignalR connection closed');
            isSignalRConnected = false;
            setTimeout(initializeSignalR, 5000);
        });

    } catch (error) {
        console.error('❌ SignalR initialization error:', error);
        setTimeout(initializeSignalR, 5000);
    }
}

function handleNotificationReceived(notification) {
    const badge = document.getElementById('notifCountBadge');
    if (badge) {
        const currentCount = parseInt(badge.textContent) || 0;
        badge.textContent = currentCount + 1;
    }

    if (window.SohbaApp && SohbaApp.toast) {
        const icon = getNotificationIcon(notification.notificationType);
        SohbaApp.toast(`${icon} ${notification.message}`, 'success');
    }

    const list = document.getElementById('notifList');
    const dropdown = document.getElementById('notifDropdown');
    if (list && dropdown && !dropdown.classList.contains('hidden')) {
        const notifHtml = `
            <div class="flex items-start gap-3 px-4 py-3 hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors border-b border-gray-50 bg-blue-50/50" data-notification-id="${notification.id}">
                <div class="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-[#345e69]/10 flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0">
                    <span class="text-[#345e69]">${getNotificationIcon(notification.notificationType)}</span>
                </div>
                <div class="flex-1 min-w-0">
                    <p class="text-sm text-gray-800">${notification.message}</p>
                    <p class="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-0.5">Just now</p>
                </div>
                <button onclick="markNotificationAsRead('${notification.id}')"
                        class="text-xs text-[#345e69] hover:underline self-start mt-1">
                    Mark read
                </button>
            </div>
        `;
        list.insertAdjacentHTML('afterbegin', notifHtml);
    }

    updateNotificationCount();
}

// ============================================================
// EXPOSE FUNCTIONS TO GLOBAL SCOPE
// ============================================================

window.markNotificationAsRead = markNotificationAsRead;
window.markAllNotificationsAsRead = markAllNotificationsAsRead;
window.deleteNotification = deleteNotification;
window.updateNotificationCount = updateNotificationCount;
window.loadNotifications = loadNotifications;
window.initializeSignalR = initializeSignalR;

// ============================================================
// INIT NOTIFICATION SYSTEM
// ============================================================

function initNotificationSystem() {
    const notifBtn = document.getElementById('notifBtn');
    const notifDropdown = document.getElementById('notifDropdown');

    if (!notifBtn || !notifDropdown) {
        console.warn('⚠️ Notification elements not found, retrying...');
        setTimeout(initNotificationSystem, 500);
        return;
    }

    console.log('✅ Notification system initialized');

    updateNotificationCount();
    setInterval(updateNotificationCount, 30000);

    initializeSignalR();

    notifBtn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.stopPropagation();
        e.preventDefault();

        const isHidden = notifDropdown.classList.contains('hidden');

        if (isHidden) {
            notifDropdown.classList.remove('hidden');
            loadNotifications();
            if (!notificationConnection) {
                initializeSignalR();
            }
        } else {
            notifDropdown.classList.add('hidden');
        }
    });

    document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        if (!notifDropdown.contains(e.target) && !notifBtn.contains(e.target)) {
            notifDropdown.classList.add('hidden');
        }
    });

    notifDropdown.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.stopPropagation();
    });

    notifDropdown.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.stopPropagation();
        const markReadBtn = e.target.closest('button');
        if (markReadBtn) {
            e.preventDefault(); // Do not follow the parent <a> when clicking "Mark read".
        }
    });
}

if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initNotificationSystem);
} else {
    initNotificationSystem();
}

// ============================================================
// MOBILE SEARCH & PROFILE DROPDOWN
// ============================================================

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {

    // Profile Dropdown
    const profileBtn = document.getElementById('profileBtn');
    const profileDropdown = document.getElementById('profileDropdown');
    if (profileBtn && profileDropdown) {
        profileBtn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
            e.stopPropagation();
            profileDropdown.classList.toggle('hidden');
            const notifDropdown = document.getElementById('notifDropdown');
            if (notifDropdown) notifDropdown.classList.add('hidden');
        });
        document.addEventListener('click', function () {
            if (profileDropdown) profileDropdown.classList.add('hidden');
        });
    }

    // Mobile Menu
    const mobileMenuBtn = document.getElementById('mobileMenuBtn');
    if (mobileMenuBtn) {
        mobileMenuBtn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
            e.stopPropagation();
            if (typeof toggleSidebar === 'function') toggleSidebar();
        });
    }

});
