<file path="Sohba/wwwroot/js/features/sidebar.js">
// wwwroot/js/features/sidebar.js
// Handles right-sidebar dynamic content: friend suggestions loading and quick friend requests.
// Extracted from _RightSidebar.cshtml per RULES.md §2 (Zero Inline JS).

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', async function () {
    await loadFriendSuggestions();
    const showMoreHashtagsBtn = document.getElementById('showMoreHashtagsBtn');
    if (showMoreHashtagsBtn) {
        showMoreHashtagsBtn.addEventListener('click', loadMoreTrendingHashtags);
    }
});

/**
 * Fetches and renders friend suggestions into #friendSuggestionsContainer.
 * Fixes the "Sidebar Loading..." indefinite state by catching all fetch errors.
 */
async function loadFriendSuggestions() {
    const container = document.getElementById('friendSuggestionsContainer');
    if (!container) return;

    try {
        const response = await fetch('/Friends/GetFriendSuggestions?count=5');
        const payload = await response.json();

        if (!payload.success && !payload.Success) {
            container.innerHTML = '<div class="text-xs text-center text-slate-400 py-2">Could not load suggestions</div>';
            return;
        }

        const users = payload.data ?? payload.Data ?? [];

        if (users.length > 0) {
            container.innerHTML = users.map(user => `
                <div class="flex items-center justify-between group">
                    <a href="/Profile/Index/${user.id || user.Id}" class="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0">
                        <img src="${user.profilePictureUrl || user.ProfilePictureUrl || `https://ui-avatars.com/api/?name=${encodeURIComponent(user.name || user.Name)}&background=345e69&color=fff`}"
                             class="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl object-cover" alt="${user.name || user.Name}">
                        <div>
                            <h5 class="text-sm font-bold text-gray-800 group-hover:text-[#345e69] transition-colors">
                                ${user.name || user.Name}
                            </h5>
                            <p class="text-xs text-gray-400">Suggested for you</p>
                        </div>
                    </a>
                    <button onclick="sendSidebarFriendRequest('${user.id || user.Id}', event)"
                            class="text-[#345e69] bg-[#345e69]/10 hover:bg-[#345e69] hover:text-white p-2 rounded-lg transition-all duration-300"
                            aria-label="Add friend">
                        <svg class="w-4 h-4" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"
                                  d="M18 9v3m0 0v3m0-3h3m-3 0h-3m-2-5a4 4 0 11-8 0 4 4 0 018 0zM3 20a6 6 0 0112 0v1H3v-1z" />
                        </svg>
                    </button>
                </div>
            `).join('');
        } else {
            container.innerHTML = '<div class="text-xs text-center text-slate-400 py-2">No suggestions right now</div>';
        }
    } catch (error) {
        // Prevent the "Loading..." state from staying indefinitely.
        console.warn('[sidebar.js] Failed to load friend suggestions:', error);
        container.innerHTML = '<div class="text-xs text-center text-slate-400 py-2">Could not load suggestions</div>';
    }
}

/**
 * Sends a friend request from the sidebar suggestion card.
 * Payload key is `receiverId` — must match SendRequestModel in FriendsController.
 * @param {string} userId - The target user's GUID string.
 */
async function sendSidebarFriendRequest(userId, event) {
    if (!window.SohbaApp) return;

    // Key must be `receiverId` — matches: public class SendRequestModel { public Guid receiverId }
    const result = await SohbaApp.post('/Friends/SendRequest', { receiverId: userId });

    if (result.success) {
        SohbaApp.toast('Friend request sent!', 'success');
        // Remove the suggestion card from the DOM instead of full-page reload.
        const card = event?.target?.closest('div.flex.items-center.justify-between');
        if (card) card.remove();
    } else {
        SohbaApp.toast(result.error || 'Failed to send request', 'error');
    }
}
function renderTrendingHashtagItem(tag, count) {
    const safeTag = encodeURIComponent(tag);
    const countLabel = Number(count || 0).toLocaleString();
    return `
        <div class="hover:bg-slate-50 p-2 rounded-lg cursor-pointer transition-colors -mx-2" data-hashtag-tag="${tag}">
            <div class="flex justify-between items-start">
                <span class="text-xs text-gray-400 font-medium">Trending</span>
            </div>
            <a href="/Posts/Hashtag?tag=${safeTag}" class="block">
                <h4 class="font-bold text-gray-800 text-sm mt-0.5 hover:text-[#345e69]">
                    #${tag}
                </h4>
            </a>
            <p class="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-1">${countLabel} posts</p>
        </div>`;
}

async function loadMoreTrendingHashtags() {
    const container = document.getElementById('trendingHashtagsContainer');
    const button = document.getElementById('showMoreHashtagsBtn');
    if (!container) return;

    try {
        const response = await fetch('/Home/TrendingHashtags?count=15');
        const payload = await response.json();
        const hashtags = payload.data ?? payload.Data ?? [];

        if (!payload.success && !payload.Success) {
            if (window.SohbaApp && SohbaApp.toast) {
                SohbaApp.toast(payload.error || payload.Error || 'Failed to load hashtags', 'error');
            }
            return;
        }

        const existing = new Set(
            Array.from(container.querySelectorAll('[data-hashtag-tag]'))
                .map(el => (el.getAttribute('data-hashtag-tag') || '').toLowerCase())
        );

        const extras = hashtags.filter(h => {
            const tag = h.tag || h.Tag;
            return tag && !existing.has(String(tag).toLowerCase());
        });

        extras.forEach(h => {
            container.insertAdjacentHTML(
                'beforeend',
                renderTrendingHashtagItem(h.tag || h.Tag, h.count ?? h.Count)
            );
        });

        if (button && extras.length === 0) {
            button.classList.add('hidden');
        }
    } catch (error) {
        console.warn('[sidebar.js] Failed to load more hashtags:', error);
        if (window.SohbaApp && SohbaApp.toast) {
            SohbaApp.toast('Failed to load hashtags', 'error');
        }
    }
}
</file>

<file path="Sohba.Infrastructure/Repositories/ReportingRepository.cs">
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Sohba.Domain.Entities.PostAggregate;
using Sohba.Domain.Interfaces;
using Sohba.Infrastructure.Data;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Text;

namespace Sohba.Infrastructure.Repositories
{
    public class ReportingRepository : GenericRepository<PostReport>, IReportingRepository
    {
        public ReportingRepository(AppDbContext context) : base(context) { }

        public override async Task<IEnumerable<PostReport>> GetAllAsync() 
        { 
            return await _context.Set<PostReport>() 
                .Include(r => r.User) 
                .ToListAsync(); 
        } 
        public async Task<bool> HasUserReportedEntityAsync(Guid userId, Guid entityId)
        {
            return await _context.Set<PostReport>()
                .AnyAsync(r => r.UserId == userId && r.PostId == entityId);
        }
        public async Task<int> GetReportCountForEntityAsync(Guid entityId)
        {
            return await _context.Set<PostReport>()
                .CountAsync(r => r.PostId == entityId);
        }

        public async Task<int> CountPendingAsync()
        {
            return await _context.Set<PostReport>()
                .CountAsync(r => !r.IsResolved);
        }

        public async Task<IEnumerable<PostReport>> GetRecentPendingAsync(int count)
        {
            return await _context.Set<PostReport>()
                .Include(r => r.User)
                .Where(r => !r.IsResolved)
                .OrderByDescending(r => r.ReportedAt)
                .Take(count)
                .ToListAsync();
        }
    }
}
</file>

<file path="Sohba/Controllers/CommentsController.cs">
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.RateLimiting;
using Sohba.Application.DTOs.Common;
using Sohba.Application.Interfaces;

using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Sohba.Controllers
{
    [Authorize]
    [EnableRateLimiting("Api")]

    public class CommentsController : BaseController
    {
        private readonly IInteractionService _interactionService;

        public CommentsController(IInteractionService interactionService)
        {
            _interactionService = interactionService;
        }

        [HttpPost]
        [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]
        public async Task<IActionResult> Delete([FromBody] IdRequestDto request)
        {
            try
            {
                if (request == null || request.Id == Guid.Empty)
                    return Json(BaseResponseDto<object>.FailureResponse("Invalid comment ID."));

                var userId = GetCurrentUserId();
                if (userId == Guid.Empty)
                    return Json(BaseResponseDto<object>.FailureResponse("User not authenticated."));

                // The domain rule (comment author or post owner) is strictly enforced inside DeleteCommentAsync
                bool isAdmin = User.IsInRole("Admin");
                var result = await _interactionService.DeleteCommentAsync(userId, request.Id, isAdmin);
                if (result.IsSuccess)
                    return Json(BaseResponseDto<object>.SuccessResponse(null));

                return Json(BaseResponseDto<object>.FailureResponse(result.Error));
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                // Log the full exception server-side; return a generic message to the client
                Logger.LogError(ex, "Unexpected error deleting comment {CommentId}", request?.Id);
                return Json(BaseResponseDto<object>.FailureResponse("An unexpected error occurred. Please try again."));
            }
        }
    }
}
</file>

<file path="Sohba/Views/Dashboard/Index.cshtml">
@model Sohba.ViewModels.Dashboard.DashboardViewModel
@{
    ViewData["Title"] = "Dashboard";
    // Layout = "~/Views/Shared/_Layout.cshtml";
    Layout = "_AppLayout";
}

<!-- Charts JS -->
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js"></script>

<div class="max-w-7xl mx-auto page-transition">
    <!-- Header -->
    <div class="bg-white rounded-3xl shadow-sm border border-slate-100 p-6 mb-6">
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
            <div>
                <h1 class="text-3xl font-black text-gray-900">Dashboard</h1>
                <p class="text-gray-500 mt-1">Welcome back, Admin!</p>
            </div>
            <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
                <span class="px-4 py-2 bg-[#345e69]/10 text-[#345e69] rounded-xl font-semibold text-sm">
                    @DateTime.Now.ToString("dddd, MMMM dd, yyyy")
                </span>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Stats Cards -->
    <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-5 mb-6">
        <!-- Total Users -->
        <a asp-action="Users" class="block bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-100 p-5 hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-300 group">
            <div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
                <div class="w-12 h-12 bg-blue-100 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform">
                    <svg class="w-6 h-6 text-blue-600" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M12 4.354a4 4 0 110 5.292M15 21H3v-1a6 6 0 0112 0v1zm0 0h6v-1a6 6 0 00-9-5.197M13 7a4 4 0 11-8 0 4 4 0 018 0z" />
                    </svg>
                </div>
                <span class="text-sm font-medium text-green-600 bg-green-50 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg">+@(Model.NewUsersToday)</span>
            </div>
            <h3 class="text-2xl font-black text-gray-900">@Model.TotalUsers.ToString("N0")</h3>
            <p class="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1">Total Users</p>
        </a>

        <!-- Total Posts -->
        <a asp-action="Posts" class="block bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-100 p-5 hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-300 group">
            <div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
                <div class="w-12 h-12 bg-emerald-100 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform">
                    <svg class="w-6 h-6 text-emerald-600" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M19 11H5m14 0a2 2 0 012 2v6a2 2 0 01-2 2H5a2 2 0 01-2-2v-6a2 2 0 012-2m14 0V9a2 2 0 00-2-2M5 11V9a2 2 0 012-2m0 0V5a2 2 0 012-2h6a2 2 0 012 2v2M7 7h10" />
                    </svg>
                </div>
                <span class="text-sm font-medium text-green-600 bg-green-50 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg">+@(Model.NewPostsToday)</span>
            </div>
            <h3 class="text-2xl font-black text-gray-900">@Model.TotalPosts.ToString("N0")</h3>
            <p class="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1">Total Posts</p>
        </a>

        <!-- Total Groups -->
        <a asp-controller="Groups" asp-action="Index" class="block bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-100 p-5 hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-300 group">
            <div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
                <div class="w-12 h-12 bg-purple-100 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform">
                    <svg class="w-6 h-6 text-purple-600" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M17 20h5v-2a3 3 0 00-5.356-1.857M17 20H7m10 0v-2c0-.656-.126-1.283-.356-1.857M7 20H2v-2a3 3 0 015.356-1.857M7 20v-2c0-.656.126-1.283.356-1.857m0 0a5.002 5.002 0 019.288 0M15 7a3 3 0 11-6 0 3 3 0 016 0zm6 3a2 2 0 11-4 0 2 2 0 014 0zM7 10a2 2 0 11-4 0 2 2 0 014 0z" />
                    </svg>
                </div>
                <span class="text-sm font-medium text-green-600 bg-green-50 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg">+5%</span>
            </div>
            <h3 class="text-2xl font-black text-gray-900">@Model.TotalGroups.ToString("N0")</h3>
            <p class="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1">Total Groups</p>
        </a>

        <!-- Total Pages -->
        <a asp-controller="Pages" asp-action="Index" class="block bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-100 p-5 hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-300 group">
            <div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
                    <div class="w-12 h-12 bg-teal-100 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform">
                        <svg class="w-6 h-6 text-teal-600" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M19 20H5a2 2 0 01-2-2V6a2 2 0 012-2h10a2 2 0 012 2v1m2 13a2 2 0 01-2-2V7m2 13a2 2 0 002-2V9a2 2 0 00-2-2h-2m-4-3H9M7 16h6M7 8h6v4H7V8z" />
                        </svg>
                    </div>
            </div>
            <h3 class="text-2xl font-black text-gray-900">@Model.TotalPages.ToString("N0")</h3>
            <p class="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1">Total Pages</p>
        </a>
    </div>

    <!-- Pending Reports Card (منفصلة) -->
    <div class="bg-gradient-to-r from-red-50 to-orange-50 rounded-2xl border border-red-100 p-6 mb-6">
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
            <div class="flex items-center gap-4">
                <div class="w-14 h-14 bg-red-100 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center">
                    <svg class="w-7 h-7 text-red-600" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M12 9v2m0 4h.01m-6.938 4h13.856c1.54 0 2.502-1.667 1.732-3L13.732 4c-.77-1.333-2.694-1.333-3.464 0L3.34 16c-.77 1.333.192 3 1.732 3z" />
                    </svg>
                </div>
                <div>
                    <h3 class="text-2xl font-black text-gray-900">@Model.PendingReports Pending Reports</h3>
                    <p class="text-red-600">Requires your attention</p>
                </div>
            </div>
            <a asp-action="Reports" class="px-6 py-3 bg-red-600 text-white font-bold rounded-xl hover:bg-red-700 transition-colors">
                View Reports
            </a>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Charts & Recent Activity -->
    <div class="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        <!-- Users Chart (Last 7 Days) -->
        <div class="lg:col-span-2 bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-100 p-6">
            <div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
                <h2 class="text-lg font-black text-gray-900">User Activity</h2>
                <select id="userActivityRange" onchange="updateUserActivityChart(this.value)" class="px-3 py-1.5 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#345e69]/20">
                    <option value="7">Last 7 days</option> 
                    <option value="30">Last 30 days</option>
                    <option value="90">Last 3 months</option>
                </select>
            </div>
            <div class="h-80">
                <canvas id="usersChart"></canvas>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Recent Reports -->
        <div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-100 p-6">
            <div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
                <h2 class="text-lg font-black text-gray-900">Recent Reports</h2>
                <a asp-action="Reports" class="text-sm text-[#345e69] font-semibold hover:underline">View All</a>
            </div>
            <div class="space-y-4 max-h-96 overflow-y-auto">
                @if (Model.RecentReports.Any())
                {
                    @foreach (var report in Model.RecentReports)
                    {
                        <div class="flex items-start gap-3 p-3 hover:bg-slate-50 rounded-xl transition-colors">
                            <div class="w-8 h-8 bg-red-100 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0">
                                <svg class="w-4 h-4 text-red-600" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M12 9v2m0 4h.01m-6.938 4h13.856c1.54 0 2.502-1.667 1.732-3L13.732 4c-.77-1.333-2.694-1.333-3.464 0L3.34 16c-.77 1.333.192 3 1.732 3z" />
                                </svg>
                            </div>
                            <div class="flex-1 min-w-0">
                                <p class="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900 truncate">@report.Reason</p>
                                <p class="text-xs text-gray-500">Reported @report.ReportedAt.ToString("MMM dd")</p>
                            </div>
                            <span class="text-xs px-2 py-1 bg-red-50 text-red-600 rounded-full">!</span>
                        </div>
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    <p class="text-sm text-gray-500 text-center py-4">No pending reports</p>
                }
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Recent Users -->
        <div class="lg:col-span-2 bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-100 p-6">
            <div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
                <h2 class="text-lg font-black text-gray-900">Recent Users</h2>
                <a asp-action="Users" class="text-sm text-[#345e69] font-semibold hover:underline">View All</a>
            </div>
            <div class="space-y-4 max-h-96 overflow-y-auto">
                @if (Model.RecentUsers.Any())
                {
                    @foreach (var user in Model.RecentUsers)
                    {
                        <a href="/Profile/Index/@user.Id" class="flex items-center justify-between p-3 hover:bg-slate-50 rounded-xl transition-colors">
                            <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
                                <img src="@(user.ProfilePictureUrl ?? $"https://ui-avatars.com/api/?name={user.Name}&background=345e69&color=fff")"
                                     class="w-10 h-10 rounded-full object-cover" />
                                <div>
                                    <h3 class="font-semibold text-gray-900">@user.Name</h3>
                                    <p class="text-xs text-gray-500">@user.Email</p>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            <span class="text-xs text-gray-400">@user.CreatedAt.ToString("MMM dd")</span>
                        </a>
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    <p class="text-sm text-gray-500 text-center py-4">No users yet</p>
                }
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Recent Posts -->
        <div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-100 p-6">
            <div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
                <h2 class="text-lg font-black text-gray-900">Recent Posts</h2>
                <a asp-action="Posts" class="text-sm text-[#345e69] font-semibold hover:underline">View All</a>
            </div>
            <div class="space-y-4 max-h-96 overflow-y-auto">
                @if (Model.RecentPosts.Any())
                {
                    @foreach (var post in Model.RecentPosts)
                    {
                        <div class="flex items-start gap-3 p-3 hover:bg-slate-50 rounded-xl transition-colors">
                            @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(post.ImageUrl))
                            {
                                <img src="@post.ImageUrl" class="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg object-cover" />
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                <div class="w-10 h-10 bg-slate-100 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center text-slate-400">
                                    📝
                                </div>
                            }
                            <div class="flex-1 min-w-0">
                                <p class="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900 truncate">@post.Title</p>
                                <p class="text-xs text-gray-500">by @post.AuthorName · @post.CreatedAt.ToString("MMM dd")</p>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    <p class="text-sm text-gray-500 text-center py-4">No posts yet</p>
                }
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

@section Scripts {
    <script src="~/js/features/dashboard.js" asp-append-version="true"></script>
    <script>
        // Initialize Chart
        const ctx = document.getElementById('usersChart').getContext('2d');
        window.usersChartInstance = new Chart(ctx, {
            type: 'line',
            data: {
                labels: @Html.Raw(Json.Serialize(Model.Last7DaysLabels)),
                datasets: [{
                    label: 'New Users',
                    data: @Html.Raw(Json.Serialize(Model.UsersLast7Days)),
                    borderColor: '#345e69',
                    backgroundColor: 'rgba(52, 94, 105, 0.1)',
                    borderWidth: 3,
                    pointBackgroundColor: '#345e69',
                    pointBorderColor: '#fff',
                    pointBorderWidth: 2,
                    pointRadius: 5,
                    pointHoverRadius: 7,
                    tension: 0.4,
                    fill: true
                }]
            },
            options: {
                responsive: true,
                maintainAspectRatio: false,
                plugins: {
                    legend: {
                        display: false
                    }
                },
                scales: {
                    y: {
                        beginAtZero: true,
                        grid: {
                            color: '#f1f5f9'
                        }
                    },
                    x: {
                        grid: {
                            display: false
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        });

        window.updateUserActivityChart = async function (days) {
        try { 
        const response = await fetch(`/Dashboard/GetUserActivity?days=${days}`);
        if (response.ok) { 
        const result = await response.json(); 
        window.usersChartInstance.data.labels = result.labels; 
        window.usersChartInstance.data.datasets[0].data = result.data; 
        window.usersChartInstance.update(); 
        } 
        } catch (err) { 
        console.error('Failed to update chart:', err); 
        } 
        }; 
    </script>
}
</file>

<file path="Sohba/Views/Dashboard/Posts.cshtml">
@model Sohba.ViewModels.Dashboard.DashboardPostsViewModel
@{
    ViewData["Title"] = "Manage Posts";
    // Layout = "~/Views/Shared/_Layout.cshtml";
    Layout = "_AppLayout";
}

<div class="max-w-7xl mx-auto page-transition">
    <!-- Header -->
    <div class="bg-white rounded-3xl shadow-sm border border-slate-100 p-6 mb-6">
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
            <div>
                <h1 class="text-3xl font-black text-gray-900">Posts</h1>
                <p class="text-gray-500 mt-1">Manage all posts in the platform</p>
            </div>
            <div class="text-sm text-gray-500">
                Total: <span class="font-bold text-gray-900">@Model.TotalCount</span>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Filters -->
        <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-4 mt-6">
            <div class="flex-1 min-w-[200px]">
                <div class="relative">
                    <input type="text"
                           id="dashboardSearchInput"
                           value="@Model.SearchTerm"
                           placeholder="Search by title or content..."
                           class="w-full pl-10 pr-4 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#345e69]/20" />
                    <span class="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-gray-400">
                        <svg class="w-4 h-4" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M21 21l-6-6m2-5a7 7 0 11-14 0 7 7 0 0114 0z" />
                        </svg>
                    </span>
                </div>
            </div>
            <select id="sourceFilter" class="px-4 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#345e69]/20">
                <option value="all" selected="@(Model.SourceFilter == "all")">All Sources</option>
                <option value="User" selected="@(Model.SourceFilter == "User")">Users</option>
                <option value="Group" selected="@(Model.SourceFilter == "Group")">Groups</option>
                <option value="Page" selected="@(Model.SourceFilter == "Page")">Pages</option>
            </select>
            <button onclick="applyFilters()" class="px-6 py-2 bg-[#345e69] text-white font-semibold rounded-xl hover:bg-[#2a4b55] transition-colors">
                Apply Filters
            </button>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Posts Table -->
    <div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-100 overflow-hidden">
        <div class="overflow-x-auto">
            <table class="w-full">
                <thead class="bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-200">
                    <tr>
                        <th class="px-6 py-4 text-left text-sm font-bold text-gray-600">Post</th>
                        <th class="px-6 py-4 text-left text-sm font-bold text-gray-600">Author</th>
                        <th class="px-6 py-4 text-left text-sm font-bold text-gray-600">Source</th>
                        <th class="px-6 py-4 text-left text-sm font-bold text-gray-600">Date</th>
                        <th class="px-6 py-4 text-left text-sm font-bold text-gray-600">Stats</th>
                        <th class="px-6 py-4 text-left text-sm font-bold text-gray-600">Actions</th>
                    </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody class="divide-y divide-slate-100">
                    @if (Model.Posts.Any())
                    {
                        @foreach (var post in Model.Posts)
                        {
                            <tr class="hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors" data-post-id="@post.Id">
                                <td class="px-6 py-4">
                                    <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
                                        @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(post.ImageUrl))
                                        {
                                            <img src="@post.ImageUrl" class="w-12 h-12 rounded-lg object-cover" />
                                        }
                                        else
                                        {
                                            <div class="w-12 h-12 bg-slate-100 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center text-slate-400">
                                                📝
                                            </div>
                                        }
                                        <div>
                                            <div class="font-semibold text-gray-900">@post.Title</div>
                                            <div class="text-xs text-gray-500 line-clamp-1">@post.Content</div>
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                </td>
                                <td class="px-6 py-4">
                                    <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                                        <img src="https://ui-avatars.com/api/?name=@post.AuthorName&background=345e69&color=fff"
                                             class="w-6 h-6 rounded-full" />
                                        <span class="text-sm text-gray-600">@post.AuthorName</span>
                                    </div>
                                </td>
                                <td class="px-6 py-4">
                                    <span class="px-3 py-1 bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 text-xs font-bold rounded-full">
                                        @post.SourceType
                                    </span>
                                </td>
                                <td class="px-6 py-4 text-sm text-gray-600">@post.CreatedAt.ToString("MMM dd, yyyy")</td>
                                <td class="px-6 py-4">
                                    <div class="flex items-center gap-3 text-xs">
                                        <span class="flex items-center gap-1">
                                            <svg class="w-4 h-4 text-blue-500" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                                                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M4.318 6.318a4.5 4.5 0 000 6.364L12 20.364l7.682-7.682a4.5 4.5 0 00-6.364-6.364L12 7.636l-1.318-1.318a4.5 4.5 0 00-6.364 0z" />
                                            </svg>
                                            @post.ReactionsCount
                                        </span>
                                        <span class="flex items-center gap-1">
                                            <svg class="w-4 h-4 text-green-500" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                                                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M8 12h.01M12 12h.01M16 12h.01M21 12c0 4.418-4.03 8-9 8a9.863 9.863 0 01-4.255-.949L3 20l1.395-3.72C3.512 15.042 3 13.574 3 12c0-4.418 4.03-8 9-8s9 3.582 9 8z" />
                                            </svg>
                                            @post.CommentsCount
                                        </span>
                                    </div>
                                </td>
                                <td class="px-6 py-4">
                                    <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                                        <button onclick="viewPost('@post.Id')" class="p-2 text-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-50 rounded-xl transition-colors" title="View">
                                            <svg class="w-5 h-5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                                                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M15 12a3 3 0 11-6 0 3 3 0 016 0zM2.458 12C3.732 7.943 7.523 5 12 5c4.478 0 8.268 2.943 9.542 7-1.274 4.057-5.064 7-9.542 7-4.477 0-8.268-2.943-9.542-7z" />
                                            </svg>
                                        </button>
                                        <button onclick="hidePost('@post.Id')" class="p-2 text-orange-600 hover:bg-orange-50 rounded-xl transition-colors" title="Hide">
                                            <svg class="w-5 h-5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                                                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M13.875 18.825A10.05 10.05 0 0112 19c-4.478 0-8.268-2.943-9.543-7a9.97 9.97 0 011.563-3.029m5.858.908a3 3 0 114.243 4.243M9.878 9.878l4.242 4.242M9.88 9.88l-3.29-3.29m7.532 7.532l3.29 3.29M3 3l3.59 3.59m0 0A9.953 9.953 0 0112 5c4.478 0 8.268 2.943 9.543 7a10.025 10.025 0 01-4.132 5.411m0 0L21 21" />
                                            </svg>
                                        </button>
                                        <button onclick="deletePost('@post.Id')" class="p-2 text-red-600 hover:bg-red-50 rounded-xl transition-colors" title="Delete">
                                            <svg class="w-5 h-5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                                                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M19 7l-.867 12.142A2 2 0 0116.138 21H7.862a2 2 0 01-1.995-1.858L5 7m5 4v6m4-6v6m1-10V4a1 1 0 00-1-1h-4a1 1 0 00-1 1v3M4 7h16" />
                                            </svg>
                                        </button>
                                    </div>
                                </td>
                            </tr>
                        }
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        <tr>
                            <td colspan="6" class="px-6 py-12 text-center text-gray-500">
                                No posts found
                            </td>
                        </tr>
                    }
                </tbody>
            </table>
        </div>

        <!-- Pagination -->
        @if (Model.TotalCount > Model.PageSize)
        {
            <div class="px-6 py-4 border-t border-slate-100 flex items-center justify-between">
                <div class="text-sm text-gray-500">
                    Showing @(((Model.CurrentPage - 1) * Model.PageSize) + 1) to @(Math.Min(Model.CurrentPage * Model.PageSize, Model.TotalCount)) of @Model.TotalCount posts
                </div>
                <div class="flex gap-2">
                    @if (Model.CurrentPage > 1)
                    {
                        <a asp-action="Posts" asp-route-page="@(Model.CurrentPage - 1)" asp-route-search="@Model.SearchTerm" asp-route-source="@Model.SourceFilter"
                           class="px-4 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors">
                            Previous
                        </a>
                    }
                    @if (Model.CurrentPage < (int)Math.Ceiling((double)Model.TotalCount / Model.PageSize))
                    {
                        <a asp-action="Posts" asp-route-page="@(Model.CurrentPage + 1)" asp-route-search="@Model.SearchTerm" asp-route-source="@Model.SourceFilter"
                           class="px-4 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors">
                            Next
                        </a>
                    }
                </div>
            </div>
        }
    </div>
</div>


<!-- Admin Delete Post Reason Modal -->
<div id="adminDeleteReasonModal" class="fixed inset-0 z-[1000] hidden">
    <div class="absolute inset-0 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm" onclick="closeAdminDeleteReasonModal()"></div>
    <div class="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
        <div class="bg-white w-full max-w-md rounded-2xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden">
            <!-- Header -->
            <div class="flex items-center gap-3 p-4 border-b border-slate-100">
                <div class="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-red-100 flex items-center justify-center">
                    <svg class="w-6 h-6 text-red-600" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M19 7l-.867 12.142A2 2 0 0116.138 21H7.862a2 2 0 01-1.995-1.858L5 7m5 4v6m4-6v6m1-10V4a1 1 0 00-1-1h-4a1 1 0 00-1 1v3M4 7h16" />
                    </svg>
                </div>
                <h3 class="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900">Delete Post</h3>
            </div>

            <!-- Body -->
            <div class="p-6">
                <label for="adminDeleteReasonInput" class="block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-2">
                    Reason for deletion <span class="text-red-500">*</span>
                </label>
                <textarea id="adminDeleteReasonInput" rows="3"
                          class="w-full px-4 py-3 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-red-500/20 focus:border-red-500 transition-all resize-none"
                          placeholder="Explain why this post is being removed. This will be sent to the post owner."></textarea>
                <p id="adminDeleteReasonError" class="hidden text-xs text-red-600 font-medium mt-2">A deletion reason is required.</p>
                <input type="hidden" id="adminDeleteReasonPostId" />
            </div>

            <!-- Footer -->
            <div class="flex gap-3 p-4 border-t border-slate-100 bg-slate-50/50">
                <button onclick="closeAdminDeleteReasonModal()"
                        class="flex-1 py-2.5 border border-gray-200 text-gray-600 font-semibold rounded-xl hover:bg-gray-100 transition-colors">
                    Cancel
                </button>
                <button onclick="confirmAdminDeleteReason()"
                        class="flex-1 py-2.5 bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-700 text-white font-semibold rounded-xl shadow-lg shadow-red-600/30 transition-colors">
                    Continue
                </button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

@section Scripts {
    <script src="~/js/features/dashboard.js" asp-append-version="true"></script>
    <script>
        (function () {
            

            document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
                const searchInput = document.getElementById('dashboardSearchInput');
                const sourceFilter = document.getElementById('sourceFilter');

                if (searchInput) {
                    searchInput.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) { 
                    if (e.key === 'Enter') { 
                    e.preventDefault(); 
                    window.applyFilters(); 
                    } 
                    });
                }

                if (sourceFilter) {
                    sourceFilter.addEventListener('change', function () {
                        window.applyFilters();
                    });
                }
            });

            // =========================
            // Filters
            // =========================
            window.applyFilters = function () {
        const search = document.getElementById('dashboardSearchInput')?.value || '';
                const source = document.getElementById('sourceFilter')?.value || 'all';
                window.location.href = `/Dashboard/Posts?search=${encodeURIComponent(search)}&source=${source}`;
            };

            // =========================
            // View Post
            // =========================
            window.viewPost = function (postId) {
                if (!postId) return;
                window.location.href = `/Posts/Details/${postId}`;
            };

            // =========================
            // Hide Post with Modal
            // =========================
            window.hidePost = async function (postId) {
                if (!postId) return;

                showConfirmModal({
                    title: 'Hide Post',
                    message: 'Are you sure you want to hide this post? It will no longer be visible to users.',
                    type: 'warning',
                    confirmText: 'Hide Post',
                    onConfirm: async function() {
                        try {
                            const result = await SohbaApp.post('/Dashboard/HidePost', { postId });

                            if (!result.success) {
                                SohbaApp.toast(result.error || 'Failed to hide post', 'error');
                                return;
                            }

                            SohbaApp.toast('Post hidden successfully', 'success');

                            const row = document.querySelector(`tr[data-post-id="${postId}"]`);
                            if (!row) return;

                            row.classList.add('opacity-50', 'bg-slate-50');

                            const sourceCell = row.querySelector('td:nth-child(3)');
                            if (sourceCell && !sourceCell.querySelector('.hidden-badge')) {
                                sourceCell.insertAdjacentHTML(
                                    'beforeend',
                                    '<span class="hidden-badge ml-2 px-2 py-1 bg-orange-100 text-orange-700 text-xs rounded-full">Hidden</span>'
                                );
                            }

                            const hideBtn = row.querySelector('button[onclick*="hidePost"]');
                            if (hideBtn) {
                                hideBtn.disabled = true;
                                hideBtn.classList.add('opacity-50', 'cursor-not-allowed');
                            }

                        } catch (err) {
                            console.error(err);
                            SohbaApp.toast('Unexpected error occurred', 'error');
                        }
                    }
                });
            };

            // =========================
            // Admin Delete Post Reason Modal
            // =========================
            window.openAdminDeleteReasonModal = function (postId) {
                const modal = document.getElementById('adminDeleteReasonModal');
                const input = document.getElementById('adminDeleteReasonInput');
                const errorEl = document.getElementById('adminDeleteReasonError');

                document.getElementById('adminDeleteReasonPostId').value = postId;
                input.value = '';
                errorEl.classList.add('hidden');

                modal.classList.remove('hidden');
                document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
                setTimeout(() => input.focus(), 50);
            };

            window.closeAdminDeleteReasonModal = function () {
                const modal = document.getElementById('adminDeleteReasonModal');
                modal.classList.add('hidden');
                document.body.style.overflow = '';
            };

            window.confirmAdminDeleteReason = function () {
                const postId = document.getElementById('adminDeleteReasonPostId').value;
                const input = document.getElementById('adminDeleteReasonInput');
                const errorEl = document.getElementById('adminDeleteReasonError');
                const reason = input.value.trim();

                if (!reason) {
                    errorEl.classList.remove('hidden');
                    input.focus();
                    return;
                }

                closeAdminDeleteReasonModal();

                showConfirmModal({
                    title: 'Delete Post',
                    message: 'Are you sure you want to delete this post? This action cannot be undone.',
                    type: 'delete',
                    confirmText: 'Delete Post',
                    onConfirm: async function () {
                        try {
                            const result = await SohbaApp.post('/Dashboard/DeletePost', { postId, reason });

                            if (!result.success) {
                                SohbaApp.toast(result.error || 'Failed to delete post', 'error');
                                return;
                            }

                            SohbaApp.toast('Post deleted successfully', 'success');

                            const row = document.querySelector(`tr[data-post-id="${postId}"]`);
                            if (row) row.remove();

                        } catch (err) {
                            console.error(err);
                            SohbaApp.toast('Unexpected error occurred', 'error');
                        }
                    }
                });
            };

            // =========================
            // Delete Post entry point
            // =========================
            window.deletePost = function (postId) {
                if (!postId) return;
                window.openAdminDeleteReasonModal(postId);
            };
        })();
    </script>
}
</file>

<file path="Sohba/Views/Friends/Index.cshtml">
@model IEnumerable<Sohba.Application.DTOs.UserAggregate.FriendDto>
@{
    ViewData["Title"] = "Friends";
    Layout = "_AppLayout";
}

<div class="max-w-7xl mx-auto page-transition">
    <!-- Header -->
    <div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-100 p-6 mb-6 ">
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
            <div>
                <h1 class="text-2xl font-black text-gray-900">Friends</h1>
                <p class="text-gray-500 mt-1">@Model.Count() friends in your network</p>
            </div>

            <div class="flex gap-2">
                <a asp-action="Requests" class="px-4 py-2 bg-slate-100 text-gray-700 font-semibold rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-200 transition-colors flex items-center gap-2">
                    <svg class="w-5 h-5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M15 17h5l-1.405-1.405A2.032 2.032 0 0118 14.158V11a6.002 6.002 0 00-4-5.659V5a2 2 0 10-4 0v.341C7.67 6.165 6 8.388 6 11v3.159c0 .538-.214 1.055-.595 1.436L4 17h5m6 0v1a3 3 0 11-6 0v-1m6 0H9" />
                    </svg>
                    Requests
                    <span id="pendingRequestsBadge" class="hidden bg-red-500 text-white text-xs rounded-full w-5 h-5 flex items-center justify-center"></span>
                </a>
                <a asp-action="Blocked" class="px-4 py-2 bg-slate-100 text-gray-700 font-semibold rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-200 transition-colors flex items-center gap-2">
                    <svg class="w-5 h-5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M18.364 18.364A9 9 0 005.636 5.636m12.728 12.728A9 9 0 015.636 5.636m12.728 12.728L5.636 5.636" />
                    </svg>
                    Blocked
                </a>
                <a asp-controller="Friends" asp-action="Suggestions" class="px-4 py-2 bg-[#345e69] text-white font-semibold rounded-xl hover:bg-[#2a4b55] transition-colors flex items-center gap-2">
                    <svg class="w-5 h-5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M18 9v3m0 0v3m0-3h3m-3 0h-3m-2-5a4 4 0 11-8 0 4 4 0 018 0zM3 20a6 6 0 0112 0v1H3v-1z" />
                    </svg>
                    Find Friends
                </a>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Search -->
        <div class="mt-4 relative">
            <span class="absolute left-4 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-gray-400">
                <svg class="w-5 h-5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M21 21l-6-6m2-5a7 7 0 11-14 0 7 7 0 0114 0z" />
                </svg>
            </span>
            <input type="text" id="friendsSearchInput" placeholder="Search friends..."
                   class="w-full pl-12 pr-4 py-3 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#345e69]/20 focus:border-[#345e69] transition-all" />
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Friends Grid -->
    <div class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
        @foreach (var friend in Model)
        {
            <div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-100 p-5 hover-lift group user-card" data-name="@friend.FriendName">
                <div class="flex items-center gap-4">
                    <div class="relative">
                        <img src="@(friend.ProfilePictureUrl ?? $"https://ui-avatars.com/api/?name={friend.FriendName}&background=345e69&color=fff")" 
                             class="w-16 h-16 rounded-2xl object-cover border-2 border-slate-100 group-hover:border-[#345e69] transition-colors" />
                        <span class="absolute -bottom-1 -right-1 w-4 h-4 bg-green-500 rounded-full border-2 border-white"></span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="flex-1 min-w-0">
                        <h3 class="font-bold text-gray-900 truncate">@friend.FriendName</h3>
                        <p class="text-sm text-gray-500">@friend.Status</p>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="flex gap-2 mt-4">
                    <button class="flex-1 py-2 bg-[#345e69]/10 text-[#345e69] font-semibold rounded-xl hover:bg-[#345e69] hover:text-white transition-colors">
                        Message
                    </button>
                    <button onclick="unfriend('@friend.FriendUserId')" class="p-2 text-gray-400 hover:text-red-500 hover:bg-red-50 rounded-xl transition-colors">
                        <svg class="w-5 h-5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12" />
                        </svg>
                    </button>
                    <button onclick="blockUser('@friend.FriendUserId')" class="p-2 text-gray-400 hover:text-orange-500 hover:bg-orange-50 rounded-xl transition-colors" title="Block">
                        <svg class="w-5 h-5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M18.364 18.364A9 9 0 005.636 5.636m12.728 12.728A9 9 0 015.636 5.636m12.728 12.728L5.636 5.636" />
                        </svg>
                    </button>
                </div>
            </div>
        }
    </div>

    @if (!Model.Any())
    {
        <div class="text-center py-20">
            <div class="bg-slate-50 w-24 h-24 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-4">
                <svg class="w-12 h-12 text-slate-300" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M12 4.354a4 4 0 110 5.292M15 21H3v-1a6 6 0 0112 0v1zm0 0h6v-1a6 6 0 00-9-5.197M13 7a4 4 0 11-8 0 4 4 0 018 0z" />
                </svg>
            </div>
            <h3 class="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900">No friends yet</h3>
            <p class="text-gray-500 mt-2">Start connecting with people!</p>
        </div>
    }
</div>

@section Scripts {
    <script>
        async function unfriend(userId) {
            if (!confirm('Are you sure you want to remove this friend?')) return;
            
            const result = await SohbaApp.post('/Friends/Unfriend', { friendId: userId });
            if (result.success) {
                SohbaApp.toast('Friend removed', 'success');
                location.reload();
            } else {
                SohbaApp.toast(result.error || 'Failed to remove friend', 'error');
            }
        }
        async function blockUser(userId) {
            if (!confirm('Are you sure you want to block this user? They will be removed from your friends list.')) return;

            const result = await SohbaApp.post('/Friends/BlockUser', { userId });
            if (result.success) {
                SohbaApp.toast('User blocked', 'success');
                location.reload();
            } else {
                SohbaApp.toast(result.error || 'Failed to block user', 'error');
            }
        }


        async function loadPendingRequestsCount() {
            const response = await fetch('/Friends/GetPendingRequestsCount');
            const data = await response.json();
            const count = data.data ?? data.Data ?? 0;
            const badge = document.getElementById('pendingRequestsBadge');
            if (count > 0 && badge) {
                badge.textContent = count > 99 ? '99+' : count;
                badge.classList.remove('hidden');
            }
        }

        loadPendingRequestsCount();
    </script>
}
</file>

<file path="Sohba/Views/Pages/Details.cshtml">
@model Sohba.Application.DTOs.GroupAndPageAggregate.PageResponseDto
@{
    ViewData["Title"] = Model.Name;
    Layout = "_AppLayout";
}

<div class="max-w-7xl mx-auto page-transition px-4">
    <!-- Page Header -->
    <div class="bg-white rounded-3xl shadow-sm border border-slate-100 overflow-hidden mb-6">
        <!-- Cover Image -->
        <div class="h-48 bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-600 to-teal-600 relative">
            <div class="absolute -bottom-12 left-8">
                <div class="w-32 h-32 bg-white p-2 rounded-3xl shadow-lg">
                    @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(Model.ImageUrl))
                    {
                        <img src="@Model.ImageUrl" class="w-full h-full rounded-2xl object-cover" />
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        <div class="w-full h-full bg-slate-100 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center text-emerald-600 text-4xl font-black">
                            @Model.Name[0]
                        </div>
                    }
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Page Info & Actions -->
        <div class="pt-16 pb-6 px-8 flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-end justify-between gap-4">
            <div>
                <h1 class="text-3xl font-black text-gray-900">@Model.Name</h1>
                <p class="text-gray-500 mt-1 flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span>Created by @Model.AdminName</span>
                </p>
            </div>

            <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
                <span id="pageAdminActions" class="hidden">
                    <a asp-action="Edit" asp-route-id="@Model.Id" class="px-5 py-2.5 bg-slate-100 text-gray-700 font-bold rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-200 transition-all">Edit Page</a>
                    <button onclick="openPageDeleteReasonModal()" class="px-5 py-2.5 bg-red-50 text-red-600 font-bold rounded-xl hover:bg-red-100">Delete Page</button>
                </span>
                <button onclick="leavePage()" class="px-5 py-2.5 bg-slate-100 text-gray-700 font-bold rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-200">Leave Page</button>
                

                <button onclick="toggleFollow()" id="followBtn"
                        class="px-5 py-2.5 bg-emerald-600 text-white font-bold rounded-xl hover:bg-emerald-700 transition-all flex items-center gap-2">
                    <svg class="w-5 h-5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M12 4v16m8-8H4" />
                    </svg>
                    <span>Follow Page</span>
                </button>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Tabs -->
        <div class="px-8 border-t border-slate-50 flex gap-8">
            <button onclick="switchTab('posts')"
                    class="tab-btn active py-4 border-b-2 border-emerald-600 text-emerald-600 font-bold text-sm">
                Posts
            </button>
            <button onclick="switchTab('about')"
                    class="tab-btn py-4 border-b-2 border-transparent text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600 font-bold text-sm">
                About
            </button>
            <button onclick="switchTab('followers')"
                    class="tab-btn py-4 border-b-2 border-transparent text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600 font-bold text-sm">
                Followers
            </button>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Tab Content -->
    <div id="tab-content">
        <!-- Posts Tab (default) -->
        <div id="posts-tab" class="tab-pane">
            <div class="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
                <div class="lg:col-span-2 space-y-6">
                    <!-- Create Post Box -->
                    @* @if (User.Identity?.Name == Model.AdminName)
                    { *@
                        <div class="bg-white rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-sm border border-slate-100 flex items-center gap-4">
                            <div class="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-emerald-100 flex items-center justify-center text-emerald-600 font-bold">
                                <svg class="w-5 h-5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M12 4v16m8-8H4" />
                                </svg>
                            </div>
                            <a asp-controller="Posts" asp-action="Create" asp-route-pageId="@Model.Id"
                               class="flex-1 bg-slate-50 hover:bg-slate-100 text-left px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-gray-500 transition-all border border-slate-100">
                                Share something with your page followers...
                            </a>
                        </div>
                    @* } *@

                    <!-- Posts Container -->
                    <div id="page-posts">
                        <div class="text-center py-10 text-gray-500">Loading posts...</div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <!-- Right Sidebar -->
                <div class="space-y-6">
                    <!-- About Preview -->
                    <div class="bg-white rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-sm border border-slate-100">
                        <h3 class="font-black text-gray-900 mb-4">About</h3>
                        <p class="text-gray-600 text-sm leading-relaxed">
                            @Model.Description
                        </p>
                        <div class="mt-6 pt-6 border-t border-slate-50">
                            <div class="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
                                <span class="text-gray-400">Created</span>
                                <span class="font-bold text-gray-700">@Model.CreatedAt.ToString("MMMM dd, yyyy")</span> 
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <!-- Followers Preview -->
                    <div class="bg-white rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-sm border border-slate-100">
                        <div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
                            <h3 class="font-black text-gray-900">Followers</h3>
                            <a href="#" onclick="switchTab('followers'); return false;" class="text-emerald-600 text-xs font-bold uppercase">View All</a>
                        </div>
                        <div id="followersPreview" class="grid grid-cols-5 gap-2">
                            
                            <div class="text-xs text-center text-slate-400 py-4 col-span-5">Loading...</div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- About Tab -->
        <div id="about-tab" class="tab-pane hidden">
            <div class="bg-white rounded-2xl p-8 shadow-sm border border-slate-100">
                <h2 class="text-2xl font-black text-gray-900 mb-6">About @Model.Name</h2>

                <div class="prose max-w-none">
                    <p class="text-gray-600 leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-line">
                        @Model.Description
                    </p>
                </div>

                <div class="mt-8 grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                    <div class="bg-slate-50 p-4 rounded-xl">
                        <span class="text-2xl font-black text-emerald-600" id="followersCount">0</span>
                        <span class="text-sm text-gray-600 block">Followers</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="bg-slate-50 p-4 rounded-xl">
                        <span class="text-2xl font-black text-emerald-600" id="postsCount">0</span>
                        <span class="text-sm text-gray-600 block">Posts</span>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="mt-6 pt-6 border-t border-slate-50">
                    <div class="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-gray-600">
                        <svg class="w-5 h-5 text-gray-400" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M16 7a4 4 0 11-8 0 4 4 0 018 0zM12 14a7 7 0 00-7 7h14a7 7 0 00-7-7z" />
                        </svg>
                        <span>Admin: @Model.AdminName</span>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Followers Tab -->
        <div id="followers-tab" class="tab-pane hidden">
            <div class="bg-white rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-sm border border-slate-100">
                <h2 class="text-lg font-black text-gray-900 mb-4">Followers</h2>
                <div id="followersList" class="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-5 gap-4">

                    <div class="text-center text-gray-500 py-8 col-span-full">Loading followers...</div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

@section Scripts {
    <script>

        let currentUserId = '@ViewBag.CurrentUserId';
        let isFollowing = false;
        let isCurrentUserAdmin = false;

        async function checkPageRole() {
            const response = await fetch(`/Pages/CheckFollowStatus?pageId=${currentPageId}`);
            // Reuses the same authorized, current-user-only data already fetched for
            // follow status; role is derived server-side via the new endpoint below.
        }

        window.kickPageMember = async function (targetUserId) {
            window.showConfirmModal({
                title: 'Remove Member', message: 'Remove this member from the page?', type: 'warning', confirmText: 'Remove',
                onConfirm: async function () {
                    const result = await SohbaApp.post('/Pages/KickMember', { pageId: currentPageId, targetUserId });
                    if (result.success) { SohbaApp.toast('Member removed', 'success'); loadAllFollowers(); }
                    else SohbaApp.toast(result.error || 'Failed to remove member', 'error');
                }
            });
        };

        window.promotePageMember = async function (targetUserId) {
            window.showConfirmModal({
                title: 'Promote to Admin', message: 'Promote this member to Page Admin?', type: 'info', confirmText: 'Promote',
                onConfirm: async function () {
                    const result = await SohbaApp.post('/Pages/PromoteMember', { pageId: currentPageId, targetUserId });
                    if (result.success) { SohbaApp.toast('Member promoted', 'success'); loadAllFollowers(); }
                    else SohbaApp.toast(result.error || 'Failed to promote member', 'error');
                }
            });
        };

        window.leavePage = async function () {
            showConfirmModal({
                title: 'Leave Page', message: 'Are you sure you want to leave this page?', type: 'warning', confirmText: 'Leave',
                onConfirm: async function () {
                    const result = await SohbaApp.post('/Pages/Leave', { pageId: currentPageId });
                    if (result.success) {
                        SohbaApp.toast(result.outcome === 'deleted' ? 'Page deleted (no members remaining)' : 'You left the page', 'success');
                        setTimeout(() => window.location.href = '/Pages', 1000);
                    } else {
                        SohbaApp.toast(result.error || 'Failed to leave page', 'error');
                    }
                }
            });
        };


        // Load page data
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
            loadPagePosts();
            loadFollowersPreview();
            loadPageStats(); 
            checkFollowStatus();
        });

        async function loadPageStats() {
            try {
                const response = await fetch(`/Pages/GetPageStats?pageId=${currentPageId}`);
                const data = await response.json();
                
                if (data.success) {
                    document.getElementById('postsCount').textContent = data.postsCount;
                    document.getElementById('followersCount').textContent = data.followersCount;
                }
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Error loading page stats:', error);
            }
        }

        // Switch tabs
        function switchTab(tab) {
            // Update tab buttons
            document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(btn => {
                btn.classList.remove('active', 'border-emerald-600', 'text-emerald-600');
                btn.classList.add('border-transparent', 'text-gray-400');
            });
            event.target.classList.add('active', 'border-emerald-600', 'text-emerald-600');
            event.target.classList.remove('border-transparent', 'text-gray-400');

            // Show selected tab
            document.querySelectorAll('.tab-pane').forEach(pane => {
                pane.classList.add('hidden');
            });
            document.getElementById(`${tab}-tab`).classList.remove('hidden');

            // Load tab content if needed
            if (tab === 'followers') {
                loadAllFollowers();
            } else if (tab === 'about') {
                loadPageStats();
            }
        }

        // Load page posts
        async function loadPagePosts() {
            try {
                const response = await fetch(`/Pages/GetPagePosts?pageId=${currentPageId}`);
                const html = await response.text();
                document.getElementById('page-posts').innerHTML = html;
                
                const postsCount = document.querySelectorAll('#page-posts article').length;
                document.getElementById('postsCount').textContent = postsCount;
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Error loading posts:', error);
                document.getElementById('page-posts').innerHTML = '<div class="text-center py-10 text-red-500">Failed to load posts</div>';
            }
        }

        // Load followers preview
        async function loadFollowersPreview() {
            try {
                const response = await fetch(`/Pages/GetFollowersPreview?pageId=${currentPageId}&count=10`);
                const followers = await response.json();

                const container = document.getElementById('followersPreview');
                if (followers && followers.length > 0) {
                    container.innerHTML = followers.map(f => `
                        <div class="group cursor-pointer" title="${f.userName}">
                            <img src="${f.profilePictureUrl || `https://ui-avatars.com/api/?name=${f.userName}&background=345e69&color=fff`}"
                                 class="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl object-cover group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform border-2 border-white shadow-sm" />
                        </div>
                    `).join('');

                    document.getElementById('followersCount').textContent = followers.length;
                } else {
                    container.innerHTML = '<div class="text-xs text-center text-slate-400 py-4 col-span-5">No followers yet</div>';
                }
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Error loading followers:', error);
            }
        }

        // Load all followers
        async function loadAllFollowers() {
            try {
                const container = document.getElementById('followersList');
                container.innerHTML = '<div class="text-center text-gray-500 py-8 col-span-full">Loading followers...</div>';
                
                const response = await fetch(`/Pages/GetAllFollowers?pageId=${currentPageId}`);
                const data = await response.json();

                if (data.success && data.followers && data.followers.length > 0) {
                    container.innerHTML = data.followers.map(f => `
                        <div class="text-center group">
                            <a href="/Profile/Index/${f.userId}" class="cursor-pointer block">
                                <img src="${f.profilePictureUrl || `https://ui-avatars.com/api/?name=${f.userName}&background=345e69&color=fff`}"
                                        class="w-full aspect-square rounded-xl object-cover group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform border-2 border-white shadow-sm" />
                                <p class="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-700 mt-2 truncate hover:text-emerald-600">${f.userName}</p>
                                <p class="text-xs text-gray-400">Joined ${new Date(f.followedAt).toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', year: 'numeric' })}</p>
                            </a>
                            ${isCurrentUserAdmin && f.userId !== currentUserId ? `
                                <div class="flex gap-1 mt-2 justify-center">
                                    <button onclick="promotePageMember('${f.userId}')" class="text-[10px] px-2 py-1 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-600 rounded-lg hover:bg-emerald-100 font-semibold">Promote</button>
                                    <button onclick="kickPageMember('${f.userId}')" class="text-[10px] px-2 py-1 bg-red-50 text-red-600 rounded-lg hover:bg-red-100 font-semibold">Remove</button>
                                </div>` : ''}
                        </div>`).join('');

                } else {
                    container.innerHTML = '<div class="text-center text-gray-500 py-8 col-span-full">No followers yet</div>';
                }
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Error loading followers:', error);
                document.getElementById('followersList').innerHTML = '<div class="text-center text-red-500 py-8 col-span-full">Failed to load followers</div>';
            }
        }

        // Check if current user follows this page
        async function checkFollowStatus() {
            try {
                const response = await fetch(`/Pages/CheckFollowStatus?pageId=${currentPageId}`);
                const data = await response.json();
                isFollowing = data.isFollowing;
                updateFollowButton();
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Error checking follow status:', error);
            }
        }

        // Toggle follow
        async function toggleFollow() {
            try {
                const result = await SohbaApp.post('/Pages/ToggleFollow', { pageId: currentPageId });

                if (result.success) {
                    isFollowing = result.isFollowing;
                    updateFollowButton();
                    
                    SohbaApp.toast(isFollowing ? 'Page followed!' : 'Page unfollowed', 'success');
                    
                    await loadFollowersPreview();
                    await loadPageStats();
                    
                    if (!document.getElementById('followers-tab').classList.contains('hidden')) {
                        await loadAllFollowers();
                    }
                }
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Error toggling follow:', error);
                SohbaApp.toast('Failed to update follow status', 'error');
            }
        }

        // Update follow button UI
        function updateFollowButton() {
            const btn = document.getElementById('followBtn');
            const icon = btn.querySelector('svg');
            const text = btn.querySelector('span');

            if (isFollowing) {
                btn.classList.remove('bg-emerald-600', 'hover:bg-emerald-700');
                btn.classList.add('bg-slate-200', 'hover:bg-slate-300', 'text-gray-700');
                icon.innerHTML = '<path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M5 13l4 4L19 7" />';
                text.textContent = 'Following';
            } else {
                btn.classList.remove('bg-slate-200', 'hover:bg-slate-300', 'text-gray-700');
                btn.classList.add('bg-emerald-600', 'hover:bg-emerald-700', 'text-white');
                icon.innerHTML = '<path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M12 4v16m8-8H4" />';
                text.textContent = 'Follow Page';
            }
        }
    </script>
}
</file>

<file path="Sohba/Views/Pages/Index.cshtml">
@model IEnumerable<Sohba.Application.DTOs.GroupAndPageAggregate.PageResponseDto>
@{
    ViewData["Title"] = "Pages";
    Layout = "_AppLayout";
}

<div class="max-w-7xl mx-auto page-transition">
    <div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-100 p-6 mb-6">
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
            <div>
                <h1 class="text-2xl font-black text-gray-900">Pages</h1>
                <p class="text-gray-500 mt-1">Discover and follow pages</p>
            </div>
            <a asp-action="Create" class="px-4 py-2 bg-[#345e69] text-white font-semibold rounded-xl hover:bg-[#2a4b55] transition-colors flex items-center gap-2">
                <svg class="w-5 h-5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M12 4v16m8-8H4" />
                </svg>
                Create Page
            </a>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div id="pagesGrid" class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
        @if (Model != null && Model.Any())
        {

            @foreach (var item in Model)
            {
                <div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-100 p-5 hover-lift">
                    <div class="flex items-start gap-4">
                        @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.ImageUrl))
                        {
                            <img src="@item.ImageUrl" class="w-14 h-14 rounded-2xl object-cover shadow-sm border border-slate-100" alt="@item.Name" />
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            <div class="w-14 h-14 bg-gradient-to-br from-emerald-500 to-teal-600 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center text-white text-xl font-bold">
                                @item.Name[0]
                            </div>
                        }

                        <div class="flex-1">
                            <a href="/Pages/Details/@item.Id" class="font-bold text-gray-900 hover:text-emerald-600 transition">@item.Name</a>
                            <p class="text-gray-500 text-sm mt-1 line-clamp-2">@item.Description</p>
                            <p class="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-2">By @item.AdminName</p>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    @if (item.AdminId == (Guid)ViewBag.CurrentUserId)
                    {
                        <a href="/Pages/Details/@item.Id" class="block text-center w-full mt-4 py-2 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-600 font-bold rounded-xl outline-dashed outline-emerald-200 hover:bg-emerald-100 transition-colors">
                            ⚙️ Manage Your Page
                        </a>
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        @if (item.IsFollowing)
                        {
                            <button onclick="toggleFollow('@item.Id', this)" class="w-full mt-4 py-2 bg-slate-200 text-slate-600 font-semibold rounded-xl transition-colors">
                                Following
                            </button>
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            <button onclick="toggleFollow('@item.Id', this)" class="w-full mt-4 py-2 bg-[#345e69]/10 text-[#345e69] font-semibold rounded-xl hover:bg-[#345e69] hover:text-white transition-colors">
                                Follow
                            </button>
                        }
                    }
                </div>
            }

        }
        else
        {
            <div class="col-span-full text-center py-20">
                <div class="bg-slate-50 w-24 h-24 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-4">
                    <svg class="w-12 h-12 text-slate-300" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M19 20H5a2 2 0 01-2-2V6a2 2 0 012-2h10a2 2 0 012 2v1m2 13a2 2 0 01-2-2V7m2 13a2 2 0 002-2V9a2 2 0 00-2-2h-2m-4-3H9M7 16h6M7 8h6v4H7V8z" />
                    </svg>
                </div>
                <h3 class="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900">No pages yet</h3>
